title: Part-Time Recruiter / Talent Sourcer — India
description:
Part\-Time Talent Sourcer / Recruiter — IndiaMarketing, Development \& AI Talent Screening

We are a New Zealand\-based business building and growing multiple ventures, including Viewings.co.nz, a property technology platform for the New Zealand market.

We are looking for a sharp, organised, and practical Talent Sourcer / Recruiter in India who can help us find, speak with, screen, and shortlist quality candidates and offshore partners.

This is a part\-time / freelance role to start, with the potential to grow if the results are strong.

Important: This Is Not a CV Forwarding Role

We are not looking for someone who simply collects resumes and forwards them to us.

Your job is to properly screen candidates before they reach us.

You must speak with candidates, understand their skills, assess their personality, check their communication, review their past work where possible, and only shortlist people who are genuinely worth our time.

The goal is quality, not quantity.

What You Will Help Us Find

You will help us source and shortlist people for roles such as:

* B2B marketing interns
* Junior digital marketing executives
* SEO and content marketing people
* Email marketing and LinkedIn outreach specialists
* Lead generation executives
* Full\-stack developers
* AI / automation talent
* CRM and business process automation people
* Offshore development companies
* Remote technical teams and freelancers
* Other business support roles as needed

Key Requirement

You must have a good practical understanding of marketing, development, and AI.

You do not need to be a senior marketer, developer, or AI engineer yourself, but you must understand these areas well enough to screen candidates properly, ask sensible questions, identify weak candidates, and shortlist people who can actually do the work.

You should be able to understand the difference between someone who talks well and someone who can actually deliver.

Main Responsibilities

* Source candidates from LinkedIn, Indeed, job boards, communities, referrals, WhatsApp groups, and other channels
* Speak directly with candidates before recommending them
* Conduct initial screening calls
* Check communication skills, attitude, reliability, and willingness to learn
* Understand salary expectations and availability
* Confirm whether candidates can work with New Zealand time zones when required
* Review examples of past work, portfolios, GitHub, LinkedIn profiles, case studies, or campaign examples where relevant
* Ask basic role\-specific questions for marketing, development, AI, CRM, and automation roles
* Identify whether the candidate fits a fast\-moving startup environment
* Maintain a clean candidate tracker with notes and status
* Coordinate interviews with our team
* Follow up with candidates professionally
* Help compare freelancers, interns, full\-time staff, and offshore development companies

Screening Expectations

Before forwarding any candidate to us, you should provide:

* Candidate name and contact details
* Role they are suitable for
* Current location
* Experience summary
* Salary expectation
* Availability/notice period
* English communication level
* Strengths
* Weaknesses or concerns
* Past work reviewed, if any
* Your recommendation
* Why you believe this person is worth interviewing

Where suitable, we would also like you to use simple assessment methods such as:

* basic personality\-fit questions
* communication checks
* problem\-solving questions
* practical task\-based screening
* light psychometric\-style screening, if you are experienced with it

We do not need complicated testing. We need practical, intelligent filtering.

What We Are Looking For

You must be:

* Very diligent and organised
* Good at written and spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with candidates
* Good at using LinkedIn, Indeed, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, and AI tools
* Able to follow instructions properly
* Fast, practical, and reliable
* Comfortable working with a New Zealand\-based business
* Able to source both individuals and companies
* Able to judge attitude, communication, and execution ability
* Honest about candidate quality

Who This Role Suits

This role is suitable for someone who has experience in recruitment, talent sourcing, HR, staffing, or freelance hiring, especially for marketing, tech, startup, or remote roles.

You may be an independent recruiter, freelance recruiter, HR professional, or talent sourcer looking for part\-time work with an international business.

Expected Weekly Output

Each week, we expect clear progress, including:

* Candidates sourced
* Candidates spoken to
* Candidates rejected and why
* Candidates shortlisted and why
* Screening notes
* Salary expectations
* Availability
* Recommended next steps
* Offshore companies or freelancers reviewed, where relevant

How to Apply

Please apply with:

* Your recruitment or talent sourcing experience
* Types of roles you have hired or shortlisted for
* Your experience with marketing, development, AI, or remote hiring
* Your expected monthly or hourly rate
* How soon you can start
* Your availability each week
* A sample candidate tracker or shortlist format, if available

Please also answer this question:

If we asked you to find a B2B marketing person for a New Zealand property technology startup, what steps would you take in the first 7 days?

Pay: ₹9,348\.75 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Before sending a candidate to us, how would you check if they have the right skills, attitude, communication, salary expectations, availability, and startup fit? Please explain your screening process.
* Tell us about one candidate you rejected even though their CV looked good. Why did you reject them, and what did you learn from that?
* If we asked you to find a B2B marketing person for a New Zealand property\-tech startup, what exact steps would you take in the first 7 days?

title: HR Recruiter
description:
The HR Recruiter is responsible for attracting, sourcing, screening, and hiring qualified candidates to meet the organization's staffing needs. The role involves managing the full recruitment cycle, collaborating with hiring managers, and ensuring a positive candidate experience while maintaining compliance with company policies and employment regulations.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract top talent.
* Create and post job advertisements on job boards, social media, and company career portals.
* Source candidates through various channels, including databases, referrals, networking, and professional platforms.
* Screen resumes and applications to identify suitable candidates.
* Conduct phone, virtual, and in\-person interviews.
* Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring managers.
* Perform reference checks and background verification as required.
* Prepare and extend job offers to selected candidates.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for future hiring needs.
* Ensure compliance with employment laws, company policies, and diversity hiring initiatives.
* Participate in employer branding and recruitment events such as job fairs and campus drives.
* Generate recruitment reports and provide hiring updates to management.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or HR operations.
* Knowledge of recruitment processes, interview techniques, and employment regulations.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms.

Skills and Competencies

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.
* Organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR software.
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* Attention to detail and confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

* HR certification (e.g., SHRM\-CP, PHR) is an advantage.
* Experience recruiting across multiple departments and job levels.
* Knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Time\-to\-fill positions.
* Quality of hires.
* Candidate satisfaction.
* Offer acceptance rate.
* Recruitment cost per hire.
* Hiring manager satisfaction.

title: Head Of Compensation & Benefits
description:
**Company Description**  

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.


 We’re an award\-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:

* UK \& Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft \& Oracle partner
* 3300\+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10\+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland \& UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK \& Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you.

 **Job Description**  

Version 1 is seeking a Head of Compensation \& Benefits to lead the design, implementation, and management of our global total reward strategy. As the business continues to scale across multiple regions, this role will ensure our compensation and benefits programmes are competitive, fair, and aligned with our growth objectives.


You will take ownership of pay structures, job evaluation frameworks, benefits provision, and reward programmes across all Version 1 locations. Working closely with senior leadership, Finance, and People teams, you will use market data and internal analytics to shape reward decisions that attract, retain, and motivate talent globally.


This is a strategic and hands\-on role, suited to someone who combines deep technical expertise in compensation and benefits with strong commercial awareness and the ability to operate across multiple jurisdictions.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and execution of Version 1’s global compensation and benefits strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and market competitiveness.
* Manage and develop the Compensation \& Benefits team, setting clear goals, reviewing outputs, and supporting professional growth.
* Design and maintain job evaluation and grading frameworks to ensure internal equity and consistency across all regions.
* Conduct regular market benchmarking and salary surveys to inform pay positioning and ensure competitiveness in key talent markets including India, UK, and Ireland.
* Own the annual pay review and bonus cycle end to end, partnering with Finance and senior leadership on budgeting, modelling, and communications.
* Design, implement, and manage employee benefits programmes across all operating regions, ensuring they meet local requirements and employee needs.
* Develop and maintain total reward statements and communications that help employees understand the full value of their package.
* Provide data\-driven insights and reporting on compensation and benefits spend, trends, and effectiveness to senior leadership.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant employment legislation, tax regulations, and reporting requirements relating to pay and benefits across all jurisdictions.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to develop competitive offer frameworks and support hiring decisions with market data.
* Support M\&A activity by conducting compensation and benefits due diligence and leading the harmonisation of reward programmes for acquired entities.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and tools, including increased use of technology and automation in reward administration.
* Manage relationships with external benefits providers, brokers, and consultants, ensuring value for money and quality of service.
* Contribute to broader People team strategy, bringing a reward and total compensation perspective to strategic discussions.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Compensation \& Benefits (e.g. GRP, CCP, CIPD) is desirable.
* 8\+ years of experience in compensation and benefits, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership role.
* Proven track record of designing and managing compensation and benefits programmes across multiple countries.
* Strong knowledge of job evaluation methodologies (e.g. Willis Towers Watson, Mercer, Hay).
* Deep understanding of employment legislation, tax, and regulatory requirements relating to pay and benefits across India, UK, and Ireland.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in compensation modelling, benchmarking, and data analysis.
* Experience with HRIS and compensation management platforms (knowledge of Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar would be an advantage).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex reward data clearly to senior leadership.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to balance employee value with business affordability.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Version 1?**


 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance\-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression \& mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance \& Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards \& ‘Call\-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION\- Social Media Analyst** 

Department Name: Human Resources

Employment Type: Internship (3\-6 months )

Location: Noida

Position : Social Media Analyst

Reporting Manager: Manager

Qualification: Any Graduate

Experience: Fresher

**About the Role**

We're looking for a creative, curious, and slightly obsessive\-about\-social\-media intern to join our team and get real, hands\-on exposure to running social media for both RevX Hospitality and our client accounts. You'll actually help plan content, track what's working, connect with influencers, and see how a brand's online presence is built one post at a time. If you love scrolling through great content and thinking "I could make this better," and you're curious about how brands use data to grow online. The ideal candidate should be capable of managing multiple accounts while ensuring brand consistency and achieving business objectives.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Content \& Strategy**

* Assist in developing social media strategies for RevX Hospitality and select client accounts and help manage and maintain multiple platforms — LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), and others.
* Support the creation, scheduling, and publishing of content aligned with brand and campaign goals.
* Assist with day\-to\-day social media management for client accounts, keeping messaging consistent and on\-time.
* Help brainstorm content ideas by tracking trends, competitor activity, and what's working in the industry.
* Monitor and respond to social media comments and DMs promptly, maintaining a consistent, on\-brand, and friendly tone across all platforms.
* Support outreach to identify, connect, and coordinate with relevant influencers and content creators for collaborations — from first message to content approval and posting.
* Assist in tracking influencer campaign performance and maintaining a simple record of past collaborations.
* Support in preparing monthly and campaign\-wise performance reports with simple insights.
* Learn to use scheduling and analytics tools like Buffer, Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite, or Sprout Social.
* Coordinate with internal teams and, occasionally, clients to understand what a campaign needs to achieve.
* Make sure everything posted follows brand guidelines and client expectations.

**What We're Looking For**

**Good to have:**

* Some familiarity with Canva; bonus points for Adobe Creative Suite or CapCut.
* Basic understanding of social media scheduling tools (Buffer, Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite) — or a willingness to learn quickly.
* Comfortable with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* An interest in digital marketing, SEO, paid social, or content marketing basics.
* Strong understanding of social media analytics, reporting tools, and performance measurement.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, paid social campaigns, SEO, and content marketing principles.
* Experience in influencer marketing, campaign management, and partnership coordination

**Who you are:**

* Genuinely into social media — you notice trends before your friends do.
* A clear, confident communicator, both written and verbal.
* Creative with a good sense of storytelling and content ideas.
* Detail\-oriented with a bit of an analytical streak — numbers interest you as much as visuals.
* Comfortable juggling multiple accounts and deadlines at once.
* Client\-friendly and easy to work with across teams.
* Self\-motivated and adaptable — social media never really has a "quiet day."

**About RevX Hospitality**

RevX Hospitality helps hotels unlock their full revenue potential. We combine data\-driven strategy with hands\-on industry expertise to optimise pricing, boost profitability, and improve operational efficiency for our hotel partners. It's a fast\-paced, growth\-focused environment — and social media plays a big role in how we tell that story, both for ourselves and for our clients.

Website: https://revxhospitality.com/

*Ready to turn your love for social media into real, hands\-on experience? We'd love to hear from you.*

title: SOP Writer
description:
Career Opportunity: CONTRACTUAL ENGAGEMENT OF SOP WRITER

(Standard Operating Procedures \& Industrial Documentation Executive)

About Pradhan Industries

Pradhan Industries is a well\-established organization engaged in Natural Graphite Mining, Mineral Processing and Graphite Beneficiation in Odisha. With multiple mining leases, beneficiation plants and expansion projects, the Company is continuously working towards operational excellence, process standardization, industrial modernization and sustainable growth.

Our operations involve mining, crushing, grinding, flotation, drying, pulverising, packaging, dispatch and allied industrial activities supported by mechanical, electrical, stores, procurement, logistics and statutory compliance functions.

To strengthen our management systems and establish standardized operating practices across all our units, we invite applications from highly experienced professionals for the position of SOP Writer (Standard Operating Procedures \& Industrial Documentation Executive) on a contractual basis.

Position Details

Designation: SOP Writer (Standard Operating Procedures \& Industrial Documentation Executive)

Nature of Engagement: Contractual

Contract Duration: Initially 11 Months (Extendable based on performance and Company requirement)

Location: Corporate Office, Bhubaneswar

Travel Requirement: Frequent visits to Company mines, beneficiation plants and project sites in Odisha.

Job Objective

The selected candidate shall be responsible for studying the Company’s existing operations, interacting with various departments, understanding actual field practices and preparing comprehensive, practical and implementable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Standard Work Instructions (SWIs), Manuals, Checklists, Process Documents, Formats and Operational Guidelines.

The SOPs should standardize operations, improve efficiency, strengthen safety, reduce operational variations and establish uniform working practices across the organization.

Scope of SOP Preparation

The candidate shall independently prepare SOPs and related documentation for, but not limited to, the following departments and activities:

* Production
* Process / Beneficiation Operations
* Electrical Maintenance
* Mechanical Maintenance
* Stores \& Inventory Management
* Procurement \& Supply
* Material Handling \& Internal Movement
* Packaging
* Stacking
* Loading \& Dispatch
* Mining Operations \& Allied Activities
* Industrial Statutory Compliance
* Mining Statutory Compliance

The Management may assign additional departments and functions as required.

Key Responsibilities

* Study existing work practices and operational procedures.
* Visit mines, plants and project sites to understand actual field operations.
* Interact with department heads, engineers, supervisors, operators and workmen.
* Analyse complete workflows and identify opportunities for process standardization.
* Prepare comprehensive SOPs, SWIs, Manuals, Checklists, Process Flow Charts, Forms and Documentation.
* Develop department\-wise operational manuals and process documents.
* Prepare workflow diagrams, responsibility matrices and documentation templates.
* Recommend process improvements to enhance productivity, quality, safety and operational efficiency.
* Ensure all SOPs are practical, easy to understand and implementable.
* Review, update and revise SOPs whenever operational changes occur.
* Maintain proper document control, revision history and version management.
* Submit periodic progress reports to the Management.

Essential Eligibility Criteria

This position is not intended for freshers or candidates having only documentation experience.

The Company is specifically looking for a highly experienced industrial professional having practical exposure to manufacturing, mining or process industries and capable of independently understanding plant operations and converting them into standardized operating procedures.

Experience

* Minimum 8–15 years of relevant industrial experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, mining, mineral processing, beneficiation plants, heavy engineering or similar process industries shall be preferred.
* Prior experience in developing SOPs, operational manuals, ISO documentation, technical documentation or process standardization will be an added advantage.

Essential Technical Knowledge

The candidate must possess sound practical knowledge of:

* Industrial Plant Operations
* Production Systems
* Mineral Processing \& Beneficiation
* Mining Operations
* Mechanical Maintenance
* Electrical Maintenance
* Preventive, Predictive and Breakdown Maintenance
* Industrial Machinery and Equipment
* Crushers
* Conveyors
* Ball Mills and Grinding Systems
* Pumps
* Motors
* Gearboxes
* Bearings
* Dryers
* Pulverisers
* Material Handling Systems
* Workshop Practices
* Utilities
* Plant Safety
* Stores \& Inventory Management
* Procurement \& Supply Chain
* Packaging, Stacking, Loading \& Dispatch Operations
* Industrial Documentation
* Industrial Statutory Compliance
* Mining Statutory Compliance
* Process Improvement and Continuous Improvement Methodologies

Educational Qualification

Candidates possessing one or more of the following qualifications may apply:

* B.E. / B.Tech.
* Diploma in Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Mining Engineering
* Mineral Processing Engineering
* Production Engineering
* Any other relevant technical qualification with substantial industrial experience.

Desired Skills

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Strong command over written English.
* Practical industrial knowledge.
* Strong analytical and observation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex industrial processes into structured documents.
* Excellent communication and interviewing skills.
* Strong coordination abilities.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to prepare professional reports, manuals, forms and documentation.

Preferred Industry Background

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

* Mining
* Mineral Beneficiation
* Graphite
* Iron Ore
* Coal
* Cement
* Steel
* Power Plants
* Heavy Engineering
* EPC Projects
* Manufacturing Industries
* Process Industries

Performance Expectations

The selected candidate shall be expected to:

* Complete assigned SOPs within the prescribed timelines.
* Ensure accuracy, practicality and completeness of all documentation.
* Standardize processes across departments.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of all Company information.
* Work closely with the Management and departmental teams to achieve documentation objectives.

Remuneration

Consolidated monthly remuneration shall be commensurate with the candidate’s qualification, industrial experience, competency and overall suitability for the role.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated Resume to **7338405666**

Only shortlisted candidates shall be contacted for the selection process.

Pradhan Industries

Join us in building standardized, efficient and world\-class industrial systems through practical documentation, process excellence and operational discipline.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context**
Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**

**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most\-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**

**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

**Position:** Talent Acquisition Specialist
  

**Location:** Mumbai (Hybrid)
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Regular


### **About the Role**

We are seeking a driven and experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist to lead end\-to\-end hiring for our technology product organization, supporting talent needs across **India and the MEA (Middle East \& Africa) region** . This role requires a proactive recruiter who can partner closely with hiring managers, understand complex technical requirements, and deliver high\-quality talent efficiently across multiple geographies.


The ideal candidate brings strong sourcing expertise, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a solid understanding of regional hiring dynamics. You will play a critical role in building diverse, high\-performing teams while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.


### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers across India and MEA to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from requisition to offer closure across multiple geographies
* Source and attract top talent through multiple channels including job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and industry networks
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across India and MEA markets
* Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates using structured and competency\-based assessment methods
* Provide informed recommendations and market insights to hiring managers
* Drive offer discussions, negotiate compensation, and ensure timely closures
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience across all touchpoints
* Maintain accurate records in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and candidate databases
* Stay updated on talent trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring practices across India and MEA
* Continuously improve recruitment processes and drive operational excellence
* Promote fair, unbiased hiring practices aligned with Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Wellbeing commitments

### **Essential Skills \& Capabilities**

* Proven experience in Talent Acquisition or similar roles
* Strong expertise in sourcing and networking, particularly via LinkedIn and digital platforms
* Demonstrated experience hiring across a **diverse range of roles** , including Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, Project Managers, Sales Engineers, and related functions
* Experience hiring across India and/or international regions (MEA exposure is a plus)
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Solid understanding of recruitment processes, hiring metrics, and labor laws
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Strong interviewing skills including behavioral and competency\-based techniques
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
* High attention to detail and strong confidentiality standards
* Effective negotiation and influencing skills

### **Experience Required**

* 6\+ years of end\-to\-end Talent Acquisition experience within a technology product organization
* Proven experience in hiring/sourcing/recruiting for roles such as **Energy Management Software specialists, Software Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Engineering Sales specialists**
* Experience hiring for technical and/or corporate roles in a global environment
* Experience supporting hiring across India and exposure to MEA markets preferred
* Prior experience working within a People/HR team, with understanding of HR policies and the employee lifecycle

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently delivering high\-quality hires across India and MEA within timelines
* Building strong partnerships with hiring managers and regional stakeholders
* Demonstrating strong understanding of regional talent markets
* Creating a best\-in\-class candidate experience
* Contributing to a diverse and inclusive workforce

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**

**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**

**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

description:
Job Description: HR Executive / Generalist**Company Profile**

**Plasma Spray Processors Pvt. Ltd.** is an ISO\-certified pioneer in advanced surface engineering and industrial thermal spray coatings, operating for over 40 years. Located in the MIDC industrial area of Taloja, Navi Mumbai, we provide specialized coating solutions to core engineering sectors like Steel, Paper, Oil \& Gas, and Power Generation.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a reliable, structured **HR Executive** to handle day\-to\-day HR and administrative operations at our Taloja plant. This is a generalist role that bridges the gap between management and employees, overseeing everything from blue\-collar worker attendance and payroll inputs to statutory compliance and recruitment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Plant \& Shop\-floor HR Operations:** Manage daily attendance, leaves, and shift rosters for permanent technicians, engineers, and contract laborers. Maintain high discipline and resolve day\-to\-day worker grievances on the shop floor.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Source, screen, and interview candidates for both technical roles (lathe operators, plasma spray technicians, grinders) and executive/managerial roles. Coordinate the final onboarding process.
* **Statutory Compliance \& Legalities:** Ensure strict compliance with applicable labor laws and MIDC regulations. Manage records for ESIC, Provident Fund (PF), Professional Tax (PT), and the Contract Labor Act. Coordinate with local government bodies or labor consultants when required.
* **Contractor \& Vendor Management:** Supervise and track third\-party contract labor agencies. Verify contractor bills, attendance logs, and compliance documents before processing payments.
* **Payroll Processing:** Prepare and compile monthly error\-free data inputs for payroll (overtime sheets, loss of pay, bonuses, and advances) and coordinate with the finance team for timely salary disbursement.
* **Plant Administration:** Oversee office utilities, plant security protocols, housekeeping staff, fire and safety equipment tracking, and annual renewal of necessary plant licenses.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in HR, Labor Laws, or Personnel Management (MSW/MILS/MLW or similar background is highly preferred).
* **Experience:** 2 to 5 years of core HR experience **specifically in a manufacturing plant, engineering unit, or heavy workshop environment.**
* **Labor Law Expertise:** Practical knowledge of statutory compliance (Factory Act, PF, ESIC, Contract Labor regulation).
* **Language Proficiency:** **Fluency in Marathi and Hindi is mandatory** to communicate effectively with the local workforce, operators, and labor agencies. Good command over written English for drafting official policy letters.
* **Software Skills:** Good handling of HRMS/Biometric attendance systems and MS Office (Excel \& Word).
* **Location Preference:** Candidates residing in Navi Mumbai (Taloja, Kharghar, Panvel, Kalamboli, Kamothe) who can easily commute to the Taloja MIDC area.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Industry:** Construction Technology  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Statutory Compliance Experience Mandatory)  
**Salary:** ₹22,000 – ₹28,000 per month

About Bandhoo

Bandhoo is a fast\-growing Construction Technology company dedicated to transforming workforce management and statutory compliance across the construction industry. We are seeking a proactive, detail\-oriented, and enthusiastic **HR \& Compliance Executive** to support our HR operations while ensuring adherence to labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.

This role is ideal for candidates with hands\-on experience in **PF, ESI, labour law compliance, contractor management, workforce coordination, and statutory documentation**. The candidate will work closely with project teams, contractors, and government authorities to ensure complete compliance across all project sites.

**Note:** Practical experience in statutory and labour law compliance is mandatory. Applications without relevant compliance exposure will not be considered.

Key Responsibilities: **Statutory \& Labour Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, including:
* Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act
* Minimum Wages Act
* Payment of Wages Act
* Building \& Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act
* Maternity Benefit Act
* Shops \& Establishments Act
* Manage PF (EPF) and ESI registrations, returns, filings, and challan generation.
* Maintain and renew statutory registrations, licences, and permits.
* Handle BOCW cess calculations and statutory submissions.
* Coordinate with Labour Department, EPFO, and ESIC authorities for inspections, notices, and compliance matters.
* Maintain audit\-ready statutory records and support internal and external compliance audits.
* Monitor changes in labour laws and implement necessary compliance updates.

HR Operations \& Workforce Management

* Support manpower planning and workforce deployment across project sites.
* Maintain employee and contract worker records accurately.
* Coordinate onboarding formalities, documentation, ID card issuance, and labour card registrations.
* Assist the recruitment and site teams with employee joining formalities.

Attendance, Payroll \& MIS

description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 11 July 2026 **Title: Early Careers Global Coordinator and Recruiter \- UK and India**

**Department:** **Early Careers Recruitment (HR \- CPO)**

**Location: Gurgaon, India**

  

We're proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years, to more than 2\.56 million customers globally. From more than 25 locations around the world, with $619 billion in total assets, we provide investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks to private individuals. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Early Careers Recruitment team and feel like you're part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. And across our organisation, we foster a welcoming, caring and inclusive culture where people feel respected, trusted and able to be themselves. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

  



As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Early Careers Recruitment is part of the Chief People Office and works closely with business leaders, programme management, Talent Acquisition, HR and external partners to attract, assess and hire bright minds and diverse perspectives into Fidelity International. We recruit and engage future talent across graduate, intern, apprentice, insight and pipeline programmes, helping individuals take the first steps in their professional journeys while building the skills and potential our business needs for the future. In the UK, much of the work supports Investment Management early careers hiring; in India, the role will also support campus hiring for technology talent.


The team acts as a brand ambassador for Fidelity International and owns the candidate experience across early careers hiring. We combine relationship\-led attraction, inclusive assessment, data\-driven decision making and strong operational delivery to ensure our programmes are compelling, consistent, scalable and fair.

**About your role**


You will support early careers recruitment delivery across the UK and India, working closely with colleagues in both regions. Around 60% of the role will support UK early careers coordination and administration, with a focus on Investment Management, Distribution and FIL Platforms hiring. Around 40% will support India early careers hiring, primarily across technology roles, through campus recruitment delivery, university relationship management, candidate engagement and junior recruiter activity.


This role would suit someone who is highly organised, accurate, accountable and proactive, with strong English communication skills and the confidence to represent Fidelity International with candidates, universities and internal stakeholders. Working closely with Early Careers colleagues, HR, business stakeholders and external partners, you will:


UK Responsibilities:

* Support UK early careers recruitment coordination across graduate, intern, apprentice and pipeline programmes, including interview scheduling, assessment centre logistics, candidate communications, inbox management and tracker updates.
* Maintain accurate candidate, vacancy and process data in Oleeo and Workday, recruitment trackers and dashboards, supporting reporting, audit readiness and timely decision making.
* Support selection and assessment administration, including candidate progression, assessor communications, feedback collation, offer process support and joining handover.
* Coordinate candidate travel and expense processes for assessment centres, interviews and events, ensuring clear communication, accurate records and timely follow\-up.
* Support early careers onboarding administration, helping candidates and new joiners move smoothly from offer acceptance through to joining.

  

India responsibilities:

* Support India early careers hiring, primarily across technology roles, through role posting, candidate screening, shortlisting support, interview coordination, candidate management and follow\-up.
* Build and maintain productive relationships with selected universities, colleges, placement teams and student groups in India, supporting campus hiring plans and long\-term early careers talent pipelines.
* Play an active role in on\-campus recruitment events in India, coordinating interview days, assessment activity, candidate flow, stakeholder logistics and post\-event follow\-up.
* Help deliver a positive, inclusive and well\-organised experience for students, candidates, assessors and business stakeholders throughout the India campus hiring process..

  

Shared responsibilities:

* Coordinate and support early careers events, insight activities, campus engagement and virtual sessions, ensuring logistics, communications, materials and follow\-up actions are well managed.
* Support recruitment administration and operations activity, including process documentation, candidate checklists, purchase order or invoice support where required, and accurate records management.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across the UK, India and wider global Early Careers team, contributing to consistent processes, shared ways of working and practical improvements.

description:
**About BlitzenX**
 BlitzenX is a specialized Guidewire System Integrator focused exclusively on the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance industry. We help insurance carriers modernize, implement, and support Guidewire solutions through high\-performing engineering teams across the United States and India.
   

  

 As we continue to scale, we are looking for an organized and execution\-focused HR Operations Executive who ensures every new employee has a seamless experience from offer acceptance through successful onboarding.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The HR Operations Executive is responsible for managing all HR operational activities from the moment a candidate accepts an offer until they are successfully onboarded into the organization.
   

  

 This is an execution\-heavy role requiring exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously.
   

  

 This role does
 **not** 
 handle recruitment or talent acquisition. Instead, it partners closely with the Recruitment team and HR Business Partner to ensure a smooth employee onboarding experience and maintain accurate HR records.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Pre\-Boarding
   

  

* Coordinate with Recruitment for candidate handover after offer acceptance.
* Collect and verify all required employee documents.
* Track pending documentation and proactively follow up with candidates.
* Initiate and coordinate background verification.
* Prepare employee personnel files.
* Ensure all compliance documents are completed before joining.


 Onboarding
   

  

* Plan and execute end\-to\-end onboarding activities.
* Ensure Day\-1 readiness for every new employee.
* Coordinate laptop, system access, ID cards, email accounts, and required software.
* Schedule induction sessions and orientation programs.
* Facilitate completion of HR forms and policy acknowledgements.
* Conduct new hire documentation verification.
* Maintain onboarding checklists and completion status.


 HR Operations
   

  

* Maintain employee records and digital personnel files.
* Update and maintain HRMS with complete employee information.
* Manage probation confirmations and probation tracking.
* Issue employment letters and HR\-related documentation.
* Maintain leave and attendance records as required.
* Ensure employee information remains accurate and up to date.


 Compliance Administration
   

  

* Ensure statutory and company documentation is maintained.
* Maintain employee compliance records.
* Track document expirations and renewals where applicable.
* Support HR audits by maintaining organized documentation.
* Ensure adherence to internal HR policies and processes.


 Coordination
   

  

* Work closely with Recruitment, IT, Administration, Finance, and HRBP.
* Ensure cross\-functional readiness before every employee joining.
* Coordinate onboarding schedules across multiple departments.
* Track onboarding progress and resolve operational bottlenecks.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of experience in HR Operations or HR Administration.
* Fresh graduates with internship experience in HR are encouraged to apply.


**Required Skills**
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong documentation and record management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Process\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience using HRMS platforms.
* Knowledge of employee lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with onboarding and HR documentation.
* Basic understanding of Indian labor laws and HR compliance.
* Experience working in an IT Services or Technology organization is an advantage.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* 100% Day\-1 onboarding readiness for all new hires.
* 100% employee documentation completed before joining.
* 100% HRMS accuracy and timely updates.
* Zero onboarding delays caused by HR Operations.
* Background verification initiated within 24 hours of document completion.
* Employee records updated within one business day of any change.
* 100% probation tracker maintained and reviewed on schedule.
* HR audit documentation maintained with zero critical findings.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing order to operations, thrives on checklists, follows through on commitments, and takes ownership of execution. Success in this role comes from consistency, accuracy, responsiveness, and ensuring every new employee experiences a smooth transition into BlitzenX.
   

  

 If you are highly organized, dependable, and passionate about operational excellence, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Power2Her Associate
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

About the Programme


Power2Her is HSBC India Bank’s first\-ever formal returnship programme that enables promising women professionals to return to work after a career break. Launched in 2021, it is a key initiative to augment the potential of women colleagues looking to restart their career. It is also an opportunity to attract great talent and strengthen future leadership pipeline. This is a structured 6\-month journey to build the mindset and skills to integrate back into work. The participants will be entitled to a standard monthly stipend for the duration of the program. Power2Her (P2H) has played a pivotal role in infusing diversity at mid to junior levels within the bank. We have deployed 56% participants into full time roles across businesses and functions.


Who are we looking for?


If you are looking to return back to work and fulfil the criteria below then please apply by clicking the button below and send us your resume. If selected, we will be in contact within the next 2 weeks to confirm your participation and further details. If it is not for you, but you do know someone that could be interested then please do forward this on and ask them to apply!

* Minimum 5 years of professional full\-time experience
* Out of the workforce for a minimum of 6 months
* Open to opportunities for 6 months’ contract roles based in India
* Previous career history in one of the following areas: Wealth Management, Relationship Management, Service Orientation, Corporate Banking, Investment Banking, Business Banking, Trade Finance, Cash Management, Securities Services, Custody, Asset Management Sales/Service/Operations, Data Analytics, Compliance, Risk Management, Operations, Finance \& Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Business Support, Supply Chain and Procurement
* Eligible to work in India
* Must be available to attend all workshops and events related to the program


How will we support the returners?

* A well\-rounded 6 months Development Plan with structured interventions has been carefully designed to support the transition of returning candidates.
* The returners will be invited to join two curated workshops on ‘Reboot your Career \& Personal Brand’ and ‘Communicate with Confidence \& Empowered Accountability’ to support assimilate into our culture and be provided with a mentor to help navigate the eco\-system better.
* A sensitization workshop for Line Managers is organized to help create awareness on their role and aspired behaviors when managing this group.

  

Programme Features:

* P2H returners are hired across organization levels and do not have a Global Career Band
* P2H returners are hired basis business demand throughout the year
* P2H returners are entitled to 10 days Privilege Leaves that should be pre\-approved on email by the Line Manager during the 6\-month internship duration
* P2H returners are entitled to the Child\-care allowance as per policy (where required)
* P2H returners are encouraged to apply on all internal \& external jobs that are advertised basis relevance of skills from the day of joining
* P2H returners can be converted for a Full Time role on a real time basis if the returner has performed well and shows potential as per business hiring needs


Application \& Selection process for the Power2Her programme:

* To apply for the programme, please visit our website and apply
* Submit your profile by completing 7 self\-explanatory steps. Once the profile submission and e\-signature step is completed. A link to complete the psychometric assessment will appear. Please take your time to complete the assessment
* Profiles of candidates who have cleared the assessment will be shared with Hiring Managers for further evaluation
* Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews with respective business manager \& HR
* Pre\-Employment Vetting (PEV) checks will be initiated for the final selected candidate
* Employment contract for 6 months will be issued to the candidate with start \& end date post PEV checks completion which take about 2 weeks
* Induction invite will be sent with more details with the date of joining
* Experience Letter will be issued post 6 months’ program completion


Selection for Full time opportunities


Returners will be evaluated during the 6 months’ tenor. They will be evaluated for full\-time opportunities subject to performance and availability of suitable openings across businesses and functions. For more details on the programme, please reach out to rachna1\.mathur@hsbc.co.in


Reference Links


Testimonial Video Link: https://social.global.hsbc/umatube/videos/10673399

 **Additional Information**

 *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

  

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior HR Generalist
description:
**Who We Are**



Quickplay is a Content\-to\-Value Operating System for media and entertainment, connecting every stage of the content lifecycle—from ingest and enrichment to publishing and monetization—through a single, orchestrated AI system. We power video streaming for Tier\-1 operators, including Warner Bros. Discovery, TelevisaUnivision, Telekom Malaysia, Television New Zealand, and Gray Media.

  

Headquartered in Toronto with offices in Toronto, San Diego, and Chennai, Quickplay is the proven foundation that broadcasters, sports operators, streamers, and creators rely on to turn their catalog into revenue.

 **The Mission**



We are looking for you to drive new institutional capabilities and scale within our Chennai hub. This is one of the most leveraged roles on our People team—someone who will operate at the intersection of global talent strategy, local operational excellence, and organizational design. The role is intentionally split 50/50 between two halves: driving the future of our India operations and quarterbacking the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for our Chennai team.

  

This is also an AI\-forward HR role. We don't want a traditional administrator; we expect this person to help us build out the People agent stack that handles the operational layer of HR—statutory compliance hygiene, documentation, data reporting, and foundational workflows—so that you and our leadership can spend your time on the work that actually moves the needle: talent judgment, high\-touch coaching, and cultural scaling. If you’re someone who sees AI as leverage rather than overhead and wants a hand in shaping how a modern, global HR org operates in India, you’ll have the autonomy to do that here.

 **What You’ll Own**



You will perform work with a high degree of latitude, handling complex issues and serving as the in\-country liaison. This is an individual contributor role. Your key responsibilities include:


* **HR Transformation \& AI:** Actively explore, implement, and leverage AI\-driven tools to streamline HR workflows, data analysis, and employee support. You are the custodian of a "frictionless" employee experience.
* **Strategic Global Collaboration:** Partner directly with the VP of People (located in North America) to bridge the gap between global strategy and local execution. You aren't just a link; you are the local expert who ensures our global initiatives land with impact. That includes proactively communicating and driving visibility.
* **Operational Excellence in the Fundational Stuff:** Own the foundational stuff \- from employee lifecycle for India, managing statutory reporting, and on\-the\-ground activities.
* **Local HR Partnership:** Provide consultative guidance and coaching to local managers and employees to ensure alignment with corporate policies and objectives. Partner with local vendors to bring meaningful educational experiences to Quickplayers.
* **Compliance \& Culture:** Provide consultative coaching to local managers to ensure our Chennai team remains high\-performing, inclusive, and deeply connected to Quickplay’s global culture, while giving oxygen to the local culture we want to amplify. Highly competitive Carrom tournaments are just the tip of the iceberg.

  


**Who You Are**

  

* **Experienced \& Context\-Aware:** You bring 8\-10 years of progressive experience, most recently as an HRBP or Senior Generalist, ideally in a high\-growth tech environment or in a global GCC.
* **An AI Experimenter:** You don't just use HRIS systems; you look for ways to optimize them. You are curious about how automation and LLMs can replace manual HR tasks. *Side Note:* We love Google and are a G Suite company.
* **A Cross\-Border Collaborator:** You are comfortable working across time zones, managing remote reporting lines, and driving strategic direction with minimal supervision.
* **High EQ / Low Ego:** You are a great teammate who understands that HR is about people, not just policies. You provide coaching that is both direct and empathetic.
* **Agile \& Autonomous:** You prioritize ruthlessly in fast\-paced environments and are comfortable "owning the room" when representing India’s interests to global leadership.

  


**Why Quickplay?**


* **High Leverage:** You aren't just a cog in the wheel; you are shaping the strategy for our entire India operation.
* **Innovation over Administration:** We encourage you to use AI and other creative avenues to make HR "smarter." If there’s a better, or more tech\-forward way to do it**,** bring your ideas to the table, and let’s try new things together.
* **Global Exposure:** Gain direct visibility with North American leadership, coordinate and drive global processes, while building a world\-class team in Chennai.

  


**Are you ready to build the future of HR at Quickplay? If you are a tech\-forward People pro who thrives on autonomy, let’s talk**

Its dynamic approach to global growth has positioned Flutter as a dominant player in established and emerging markets, pushing the boundaries of the entertainment experience.


Flutter Entertainment is listed on both the **New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE).** We’re proud to be recognized by **TIME** as one of the **World’s Best Companies 2025** — a reflection of the passion and commitment of our colleagues across the globe.
  

Our ambition is to transform global gaming and betting to deliver long\-term growth and a positive, sustainable future for our sector. Together, we are **Changing the Game** .


**FLUTTER ENTERTAINMENT INDIA**

We are committed to crafting impactful solutions for all our brands and divisions to power Flutter's incredible growth and global impact. Our portfolio of **world\-class brands, global scale, and challenger mindset** presents a powerful combination.


We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future and the **global and local scale to achieve them.**

**OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE**

The HR Operations Trainer is responsible for designing and delivering comprehensive training programs to enhance the capabilities of HR Operations, People Services, and related stakeholders. The role focuses on ensuring a consistent and high\-quality understanding of HR processes, policies, and systems across teams.


This position plays a critical role in driving operational excellence by continuously improving training content, methodologies, and learning effectiveness. It also supports compliance and process adherence through structured learning initiatives and effective knowledge management practices.


The HR Operations Trainer collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to identify capability gaps and implement targeted training interventions. Additionally, the role is responsible for monitoring training effectiveness through assessments, feedback, and performance metrics, ensuring continuous improvement and an enhanced employee and stakeholder experience through accurate and timely HR operational knowledge.


**KEY RESPOBSIBILITIES**

**Training Design \& Delivery**

* Design, develop and deliver engaging training programs for HR Operations and People Services teams (new joiners and existing staff).

**HR Process \& Systems**

* Continuous Improvement

**Knowledge management**

* Contribute to HR Knowledge bases and ensure learning content remains accurate and up to date.
* Promote best practice and consistency across HR Operations globally or regionally.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Core HR and Transformation to align training with business priorities.
* Act as a trusted partner to leaders and managers on capability development within HR Operations.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED TO HAVE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience in HR Operations, People Services or HR Shared Services.
* Experience designing and delivering training, ideally within an HR or operational environment.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle activities.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate complex processes into clear, practical learning content.

**Desirable**

* Experience supporting HR transformation or change initiatives.
* Exposure to global or regional HR operating models.
* Experience with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and case management tools.

**Qualifications:**

* Certification in Training \& Development, HR Operations, or Learning \& Development is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of HR operations processes, policies, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools and Learning Management Systems (LMS).

**Experience:**

**Measure of Success**

Flutter is an **equal\-opportunity employer** and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. Our message to colleagues and stakeholders is clear: everyone is welcome, and every voice matters. We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future.
