title: S&C GN - TS&T – Technology Transformation Delivery - Transformation Coach - Senior Manager
description:
**Senior Manager – Transformation Office – Transformation Coach**

*Join our team in Technology Strategy \& Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to enable our most strategic clients to realize exceptional business value from technology*

**Practice:** Technology Strategy \& Transformation, Global Network

**Areas of Work:** Transformation Management, Transformation Coaching, Value Realization, Agentic AI

**Level:** Senior Manager (Level 6\)

**Location:** Bangalore / Gurugram / Mumbai / Pune / Chennai / Kolkata / Hyderabad

**Years of Experience:** 12 to 17 years

**Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture**


Are you passionate about shaping the early direction of large\-scale transformation programs and building organizational muscles to sustain them? Do you excel at guiding senior leaders and cross\-functional teams to define ways of working, embed governance practices, and drive transformation with discipline and clarity?


If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy \& Transformation and take on a senior leadership role, guiding global clients on their most complex transformation journeys — working at the heart of our clients’ most ambitious programs to set the tone, build the foundation, and enable lasting transformation outcomes, now enhanced by the power of Agentic AI.

**The Practice – A Brief Sketch**


Technology Strategy \& Transformation Practice is part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients’ most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, redefining business models and delivery approaches.


As a Senior Manager, you will be deployed at the critical early stages of transformation programs — shaping direction, enabling teams, and embedding the practices that make transformation stick. Here are some of the key initiatives you will drive:

* **Establishing Strategic Direction for Early\-Stage Transformation:** Partnering with senior client leadership to define transformation vision, governance frameworks, and ways of working at program inception.
* **Transformation Coaching \& Team Enablement:** Embedding alongside client teams to coach leaders and program workstreams on transformation management best practices, decision\-making structures, and accountability models.
* **Agentic AI\-Powered Transformation Management:** Identifying and deploying Agentic AI solutions within transformation programs to automate tracking, analysis, and realization of business value.

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a Senior Manager who brings deep expertise in Transformation Management and a hands\-on track record as a Transformation Coach. The ideal candidate excels at working in the early, ambiguous stages of large transformation programs — helping clients shape direction, define how the program will be managed, establish ways of working, and build the governance structures needed to execute with confidence.**

**You will work closely with C\-suite stakeholders, transformation leads, and program workstream owners to coach teams, embed best practices, and apply Agentic AI to accelerate program management maturity — ensuring measurable business outcomes are governed and realized throughout the transformation lifecycle.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Transformation Coaching \& Early\-Stage Strategy Formulation**

* **Orchestrate Transformation Change**– Guide and orchestrate enterprise\-wide change across business units in close coordination with talent/HR teams, ensuring transformation approaches are shaped to client context, maturity, and archetype — enabling the organization to own and sustain the change rather than depending on externally imposed frameworks.
* **Steer Culture \& Accountability** – Embed transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring governance is actively practiced.
* **Coach Leadership Teams** – Guide senior leaders and workstream heads on transformation management principles, enabling effective decision\-making, alignment, and disciplined execution.
* **Build Capability –** Build Transformation Management capability by enabling standard transformation orchestration guidelines, structured governance, change adoption, stakeholder alignment, and value realization to sustainably drive strategic change.

**Lead Transformation \& Value Management**

* **Set up \& Run TO** – Set up and run Transformation Management Offices (TMO) / Value Realization Offices (VRO) for large\-scale client engagements, owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end\-to\-end.
* **Value Discovery \& KPIs** – Conduct and facilitate value discovery workshops to identify business objectives, key value drivers, and measurable KPIs during the business blueprint phase. Build detailed business cases for transformation initiatives, working with business and functional leaders to track and report actual performance against targets.
* **Establish Program Governance** – Design and embed program structures including decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working (meetings, reporting, RAID, decision registers).

**Embedding Best Practices \& Sustaining Transformation**

* **Build Playbooks \& Toolkits –** Develop and institutionalize transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs tailored to client context and maturity.
* **Facilitate Health \& Risk Reviews –** Lead structured sessions to assess transformation health, identify risks, and co\-create corrective actions.

**Drive Agentic AI\-Powered Transformation**

* Apply hands\-on expertise in AI Agents and agentic architecture to automate and accelerate transformation management activities — including status tracking, risk identification, value analysis, and reporting.
* Identify opportunities within client programs where Agentic AI can meaningfully improve program governance, decision\-making, and value realization speed.
* Articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
* Stay current with the evolving landscape of AI agent frameworks and proactively recommend their application within ongoing engagements.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Client Advisory**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to C\-suite and senior technology leaders, architecting and guiding transformation journeys with authority and clarity.
* Apply a cross\-enterprise perspective spanning business and technology stakeholders, navigating ambiguity to pursue a consistent transformation vision.
* Collaborate with internal team members — business unit leaders, process owners, and IT teams — to capture feedback, align on initiatives, and manage change effectively.
* Maintain strong internal and client relationships through consistent delivery, proactive communication, and executive\-level presence.

  

**Core Skillsets**

**Transformation Coaching \& Ways of Working**

* Ability to orchestrate and steer enterprise\-wide transformation change — designing bespoke approaches tailored to client context, maturity, and archetype rather than applying generic frameworks.
* Experience designing and embedding program governance structures — decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working.
* Demonstrated ability to coach senior leaders on transformation management principles — enabling effective decision\-making, alignment, and disciplined execution across workstreams.
* Skill in embedding transparency, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement — ensuring governance is actively practiced, not just documented.
* Track record of building transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs — and facilitating structured health and risk reviews to identify execution gaps and co\-create corrective actions.

**Transformation Management \& Value Realization**

* Deep expertise in setting up and operating TMOs and VROs — owning governance, reporting, and value tracking end\-to\-end for large\-scale transformation programs.
* Strong command of KPI frameworks, value trees, business case development, and value discovery — translating business objectives into measurable performance targets.
* Prior exposure using AI to manage large transformation programs — AI\-driven dashboards, intelligent tracking, and analytics to enhance program visibility and value outcomes.

**Consulting \& Advisory**

* Strong consulting foundation — strategic analysis, program management, and C\-suite stakeholder engagement across business and technology functions.
* Facilitation skills across Design Thinking, Value Stream Mapping, and transformation roadmap sessions; trusted advisor capability to navigate ambiguity and resolve cross\-functional tensions.

**Good to Have Skills**

**Transformation Maturity Assessment**

* Familiarity with transformation maturity models and assessment frameworks used to baseline program management capability and track improvement over time.
* Experience using structured diagnostics to identify program execution risks and recommend governance remediation actions.

**Agentic AI \& AI\-Powered Delivery**

* Hands\-on experience creating and leveraging AI Agents and agentic architecture in enterprise transformation contexts.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, deploy, and articulate Agentic AI use cases within ongoing programs.
* Familiarity with leading AI agent frameworks and LLM\-powered workflow automation tools.

**Industry Depth**

* Good exposure to few of the following industries: Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, or Mining and Resources.

**Read More About Us**

* The Rise of Forerunners
* Recent Blogs

**Your Experience Counts!**

* Master’s degree required; MBA from a Tier\-1 institution is strongly preferred.
* 12–17 years of large\-scale consulting experience, managing teams in a consulting environment or as part of an organization’s internal strategy/transformation capability.
* 5\+ years of direct experience leading or contributing to a Value Realization Office (VRO) or Transformation Management Office (TMO) for large programs.
* Demonstrated experience as a Transformation Coach on large enterprise programs — shaping early\-stage direction, defining ways of working, and embedding governance and accountability frameworks.
* Demonstrated hands\-on exposure to Agentic AI and AI agent frameworks applied within enterprise transformation or program governance contexts.
* Experience leading or managing large cross\-functional teams: planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating workshops, and developing executive\-level recommendations.
* Working knowledge of KPIs, value trees, and other relevant measures specific to large digital transformation programs.
* Experience leading workshops using techniques such as Design Thinking, Value Stream Mapping, User Story Mapping etc.

**What’s in it for you?**

* An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients.
* Potential to co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, and business intelligence professionals to shape innovative solutions leveraging emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything — from how you serve clients to how you operate as a professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen and grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

**About Accenture**


Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions — underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network — Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With 786,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

**About Accenture Strategy \& Consulting**


Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models, and the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy’s services include those provided by our Capability Network — a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. For more information visit https://www.accenture.com/us\-en/Careers/capability\-network.


Accenture Capability Network \| Accenture in One Word

*At the heart of every great change is a great human. If you have ideas, ingenuity and a passion for making a difference,* come and be a part of our team*.*

description:
**Role Overview**


Our India operation is one of the fastest\-growing parts of One Retail Group, making this an exciting opportunity to join the business at a pivotal stage of our global growth.


We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and people\-focused Office Admin \& HR Executive to become the operational backbone of our India office. This is a varied, hands\-on role that combines office management, HR administration and executive support to ensure our growing team has everything they need to perform at their best.


Working closely with the India Office Lead and partnering with colleagues across our UK and global teams, you will take ownership of the day\-to\-day running of the office while supporting the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to payroll, engagement, performance processes and office operations.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys solving problems, takes ownership without being asked, and is happy switching between strategic priorities and practical day\-to\-day tasks. No two days are the same, and every task you complete will help create a professional, efficient and enjoyable workplace for our growing India team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Office Operations \& Executive Support**

* Take ownership of the smooth day\-to\-day running of the India office, ensuring a professional, organised and productive working environment.
* Act as the primary support for the India Office Lead, managing calendars, coordinating meetings, supporting priorities and assisting with operational and administrative activities.
* Manage relationships with our co\-working space provider and other external suppliers, ensuring office facilities operate efficiently and all payments are processed on time.
* Coordinate business travel, visitor management, meeting logistics and general office administration.
* Ensure the office remains fully stocked with supplies, equipment and day\-to\-day essentials, creating a welcoming environment for employees and visitors.

**People Operations \& HR Administration**

* Coordinate recruitment activities, including preparing job descriptions, liaising with recruitment partners, scheduling interviews and supporting hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding and offboarding experience, ensuring new starters have everything they need from day one.
* Act as the first point of contact for general HR queries, providing guidance and escalating matters where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Coordinate the monthly payroll process with our third\-party payroll provider, ensuring all information is accurate and submitted on time.
* Support the implementation of performance review processes and follow up on agreed development actions.
* Assist with employee engagement initiatives, surveys and activities that help create a positive and inclusive workplace.
* Work with the UK Head Office to support training and development programmes for employees.
* Assist in maintaining HR policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with local legislation and alignment with global business standards.

**Technology, Facilities \& Administration**

* Coordinate laptop provisioning, employee IT setup and office technology requirements by working with external IT providers and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain company asset registers and ensure office equipment is tracked and managed effectively.
* Process office invoices, expense claims and purchasing requests accurately and on time.

description:

* **Contact Person**: Abhay Mulik

* **Mobile**: \+91 9972877452

* **WhatsApp**: \+91 9113627282

* **Email**: abhay.mulik@in.g4s.com

  



### **Position Summary:**



The **Security Officer** acts as the operational lead at the site level, responsible for implementing security procedures, supervising guard personnel, coordinating with clients, and ensuring all security and safety standards are consistently met. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.

  



### **Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Site Command and Control:**


* Function as the second\-in\-command or site head (depending on site size).
  


* Lead and monitor all security operations at the designated client site.
  


* Ensure guards follow all post duties, site\-specific instructions (SSIs), and G4S protocols.
  



**2\. Team Supervision:**


* Supervise the deployment and performance of Security Supervisors and Guards.
  


* Conduct daily muster, uniform inspection, and tool checks.
  


* Address absenteeism, disciplinary issues, and performance shortfalls.
  



**3\. Client Coordination:**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client at the site.
  


* Conduct regular meetings with client representatives to address concerns or updates.
  


* Ensure client satisfaction through prompt issue resolution and quality service delivery.
  



**4\. Operational Execution:**


* Ensure access control systems, patrolling routines, visitor management, and asset protection are functioning as per SOP.
  


* Monitor surveillance systems and review CCTV footage in coordination with client security teams.
  


* Supervise material movement, vehicle access, and contractor/staff entry protocols.
  



**5\. Incident Management:**


* Act promptly in case of incidents like theft, fire, medical emergencies, or safety violations.
  


* Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
  


* File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.
  



**6\. Documentation \& Reporting:**


* Maintain daily shift logs, occurrence reports, visitor data, and material movement records.
  


* Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
  


* Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit\-ready.
  



**7\. Training \& Compliance:**


* Conduct on\-the\-job training, drills, and refreshers for site guards.
  


* Ensure adherence to G4S grooming, behavior, and discipline standards.
  


* Support HR and compliance teams during audits, inspections, or client reviews.

  



### **Eligibility Criteria:**


* **Education:** Minimum 12th Pass; Graduate preferred.
  


* **Experience:**  



	+ 4–8 years of experience in the security industry, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or officer\-level role.
	  
	
	
	+ Background in defence/police/paramilitary preferred.
* **Age:** 28 to 50 years (Flexible for ex\-servicemen).
  


* **Physical Standards:** Fit and alert; Minimum height 170 cm.

  



### **Key Skills \& Attributes:**


* Strong leadership and coordination skills.
  


* Good written and verbal communication (English, Hindi, and local language).
  


* Proficiency in report writing, basic computer use (MS Office, email).
  


* Knowledge of safety procedures, emergency protocols, and fire prevention.
  


* Ability to handle pressure and work rotational shifts.

  



### **Working Conditions:**


* Site\-based duty with 8/12\-hour shifts depending on deployment.
  


* 6\-day work week or rotational off, as per duty schedule.
  


* Uniform, mobile phone (if applicable), ID card, and duty gear provided.
  


* PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, leave benefits, and insurance as per statutory norms.

  



### **Remuneration:**


* As per G4S internal grade structure and prevailing **Minimum Wages for Security Officer/Supervisor category** in the respective state/UT.
  


* Site\-based allowances, night duty allowance, and performance incentives may apply.

  



### **Career Path within G4S:**

title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Benefits Operations Special Projects Lead
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling is at the forefront of the AI revolution in business operations, and we’re looking for a visionary Special Projects Lead to redefine how benefits are managed. This isn’t just an operations role; it’s an invitation to architect the future of our Benefits Operations team by embedding AI at the heart of our most critical workflows.

  

You won’t just be identifying inefficiencies—you’ll be building the solutions that eliminate them. From carrier operations to complex discrepancy resolution, you will have a direct hand in shipping proofs of concept that fundamentally transform team throughput and accuracy. This is your chance to turn manual, high\-volume tasks into seamless, automated engines of growth.  

This is a dual\-focus role designed for a strategist who excels at the intersection of high\-impact Business Operations and AI\-enabled innovation. We need someone with the sharp, analytical instincts of a management consultant to tackle complex operational challenges, paired with a practical, hands\-on curiosity for applying AI to drive meaningful efficiency. You don't need to be technical, but you must be adept at learning new AI tools, understanding their capabilities, and applying them effectively, but you must have the drive to identify high\-leverage problems and the follow\-through to build the automated solutions that solve them.**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Size and execute on AI acceleration opportunities** — identify high\-leverage areas to reduce manual work across benefits ops workflows, conducting cost\-benefit analyses to prioritize projects based on potential ROI and impact.
* **Map and automate high\-volume triage workflows** — identify the most common root causes behind recurring operational discrepancies, build deterministic resolution paths for cases that don't require judgment, and layer in AI\-assisted triage for the rest.
* **Build and ship proofs of concept** — take ownership of end\-to\-end AI workflows, bring them to production, and measure their impact on team throughput. The goal is working solutions, not slide decks.
* **Document and scale what works** — translate findings into reusable SOPs, Confluence pages, and Loom walkthroughs so the team can understand, maintain, and build on what you've built.
* **Partner closely with ops leads** — embed in the team to understand where manual work is highest, where errors concentrate, and what makes a good automation target. Surface those opportunities and drive them forward.
* **Build a shared repository of AI use cases** — track what's been tried and what's worked across Benefits Ops and adjacent teams, and make it easy for others to build on that foundation.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 1–3 years of professional experience in business operations, strategy and operations, management consulting, or a similar fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree (required).
* Genuine curiosity about AI tools and how to apply them practically — prior experience with AI productivity tools is a strong plus, but an engineering background is not required.
* Strong analytical and written communication skills, with the ability to break down complex workflows and communicate clearly across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, prioritize effectively, and make progress in ambiguous environments.
* A bias toward action — you form a point of view quickly, move without waiting for a perfect brief, and follow through.
* Experience in benefits, insurance, or HR tech is a plus but not required.

title: HR Technology Analyst - Workday Recruit
description:
**What you will do**


As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting configuration requests and participating in projects. You will be a strategic business partner who applies technology to support business requirements.


Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR Centers of Expertise and the HR community to answer functionality questions, resolve issues, work with vendors on system‑related concerns, and test new functionality. The team is involved in many different projects, enabling the HR Technology Analyst to work across the business to ensure successful HR processes.

**A key focus of this role is supporting and enhancing Workday Recruit, partnering closely with the Talent Acquisition CoE to design, configure, and optimize recruiting processes that improve system performance and the overall candidate experience.** You will also support and manage day‑to‑day operations with Paradox and HiredScore to ensure smooth recruiter workflows and high‑quality candidate engagement.


The Analyst will be involved in the deployment of new Workday features as well as operational improvements; this includes implementing new security roles, leading configuration changes, and executing end\-to\-end testing for Workday upgrades.

**How you will do it**

* Configure changes in Workday based on business requirements.
* Configure and maintain Workday Recruit processes, including job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, and offer workflows to support a seamless recruiting lifecycle.
* Project team member/lead for the design and implementation of new Workday functionalities, including business process configuration, testing, interface and integration support, implementation through deployment, and postproduction support.
* Support processes within Workday, with a particular focus on recruiting workflows and TA related functionality.
* Develop strong relationships with internal partners, including the Talent Acquisition CoE, to gain an understanding of business requirements and translate them into effective system solutions.
* Create custom Workday reports as needed to meet business needs/objectives.
* Plan, coordinate, and implement testing efforts for changes within Workday, including recruiting related enhancements and integrations.
* Support the design, development, and performance of Workday and related business data and processes. Focus on identifying trends, resolving root causes, predicting future implications, and finding solutions to drive effective business decisions.
* Proactively identify and assist in prioritizing opportunities to streamline business and/or system processes, especially within the recruiting lifecycle.
* Lead biyearly Workday upgrades, including end\-to\-end testing of Workday Recruit functionality.
* Partner with the Talent Acquisition CoE to analyze and enhance the candidate journey, using Workday Recruit configuration and supporting technologies to streamline application flow and improve candidate experience.
* Oversee daily operations and optimization of Paradox and HiredScore, including troubleshooting issues, monitoring performance, driving adoption, and identifying enhancements that improve recruiter efficiency and candidate engagement.

**What we look for**

**Required**

* Degree in business or management information systems, HR (CIPD), or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience with case management, specifically ServiceNow.
* Experience with Human Capital Management systems, ideally Workday.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to prioritize and find solutions in a timely manner.
* Self\-motivated and self\-organized working style with the ability to work effectively on diverse project teams.
* Customer service focus and flexibility in supporting business unit needs.
* Demonstrated competence in presenting concepts clearly and accurately with strong written and verbal interpersonal skills. Able to positively represent Johnson Controls and communicate with others at varying managerial and technical levels.
* Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* History of significant customer satisfaction, building rapport, and influencing decisions while working in a consultative role with customers.

**Preferred**


We’d ideally love you to have experience as a contributing team member within HR operational projects and new implementations, including the full change request lifecycle (solution design, configuration, testing, communication, etc.). An overall understanding of HR data, HR processes, and the change/implementation life cycle is important.

**Workday experience is highly desirable**, particularly in configuring and supporting:

* Workday Recruit (job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, offer workflows, and recruiting related security)
* Payroll
* Compensation
* Time Off
* Reporting
* Security

title: Testing Engineer (Fresher)
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


We are seeking a highly skilled and detail\-oriented Software Testing Engineer to join our dynamic software development team. As a Software Testing Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through rigorous testing procedures. Your expertise will contribute to the overall success of our projects by identifying and resolving potential issues before the software is released to our customers. The Testing Engineer conducts manual and automated testing, including functional, regression, integration, and performance testing, and tracks defects using established processes. Collaboration with cross\-functional teams, effective communication of test results and risks, adherence to quality\-assurance processes, and continuous learning to enhance testing practices are key aspects of the Testing Engineer’s role. We offer competitive compensation packages and a permanent work\-from\-home option after the probation period.


**Roles and Responsibilities**
------------------------------


Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on software requirements and design specifications.


Conduct functional, regression, performance, and usability testing to identify defects and ensure software meets quality standards.


Collaborate with software developers and business analysts to understand project requirements and participate in requirement analysis sessions.


Perform manual testing as well as develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry\-standard testing tools.


Conduct root\-cause analysis of defects, document and track them using bug tracking systems, and work closely with the development team to resolve issues.


Continuously monitor and improve the software testing process, including identifying areas for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practices.


Provide timely and accurate reports on testing progress, test coverage, and defects to stakeholders and project teams.


Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software testing to enhance your skills and contribute to the team’s growth.


Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of software development processes and quality assurance methodologies.


Investigate and reproduce reported issues to identify root causes and provide detailed bug reports to development teams.


For further inquiries or more information, please feel free to reach out to us via email at recruitment.chn@syncfusion.com. We are happy to assist you and provide any additional details you may require.


**Eligibility**
---------------


### **Academic Qualifications**


BE/B.Tech, ME/M.Tech, M.Sc (CS, IT), MCA.


2023 graduates with a minimum of 65% in UG and PG (if applicable).


Minimum of 75% in SSLC and HSC.


No gaps of any kind.


**Skills Required**
-------------------


A course certificate related to software testing would be advantageous.


Strong knowledge of software testing processes, methodologies, and tools.


Familiarity with programming languages, such as Java, Python, or C\+\+, is desirable.


Knowledge of test automation frameworks and tools like Selenium, JUnit, or TestNG.


A solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies.


Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.


Strong ability to analyze complex scenarios, reproduce issues, and troubleshoot problems.


The ability to think critically and solve problems efficiently.


Strong communication and interpersonal skills are necessary to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, including developers and project managers.


The ability to articulate issues, document defects, and provide constructive feedback.


Familiarity with different testing methodologies, such as black\-box testing, white\-box testing, and user acceptance testing. Additionally, experience with various testing tools and frameworks, such as Jira, TestRail, or Jenkins, can enhance your candidacy.

* Comfortable on Linux, with Git\-based workflows, containerized deployment (Docker), and CI pipelines.
* Demonstrated practice with unit and integration testing (pytest, JUnit, Jest, or equivalent).


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Familiarity with time\-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, or similar) for sensor and telemetry workloads.
* Experience with on\-premises or LAN\-based deployment of real\-time systems.
* Familiarity with WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events, or gRPC for streaming data to clients.
* Experience with observability stacks (structured logging, Prometheus/Grafana, or comparable).
* Exposure to signal processing, DSP, or sensor telemetry domains.


**Why Join Us?**

title: Senior RF Design Engineer +
description:
**Build Your Dreams at**
**Constelli.**
---------------------------------------


FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.


We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.

  


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:

* Software \- defined Radar simulators.
* Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
* Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
* Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.

Who Thrives Here
* Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
* Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
* Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
* Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.

What You’ll Experience
* End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
* Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
* Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.

  
**About Us**


We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting\-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission\-critical applications.


**About the role**


As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring\-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications.


The role includes RF signal\-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front\-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system\-level requirements into circuit\-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support.



Key Responsibilities


* Circuit Design \& Analysis
	+ Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front\-end modules up to 40 GHz.
	+ Perform RF system and circuit\-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1dB, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance.
	+ Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system\-level co\-simulation.
	+ Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
	+ Define component derating, worst\-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high\-reliability aerospace and defence hardware.
	+ Translate system\-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications.
* Systems Architecture \& Integration
	+ Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module\-level implementation planning.
	+ Lead antenna\-to\-baseband RF signal\-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down\-converter applications.
	+ Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface.
	+ Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements.
	+ Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack\-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return\-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed\-signal partitioning.
	+ Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high\-power PA thermal design.
	+ Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces.
* Product Development \& Qualification
	+ Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S\-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1dB, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre\-compliance.
	+ Perform prototype bring\-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation\-to\-measurement correlation.
	+ Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL\-STD\-461 EMC and MIL\-STD\-810 environmental requirements.
	+ Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support.
	+ Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence.
	+ Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade\-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers.

  

Required Qualifications


* B.Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment
* Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent.
* Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise\-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters.
* Experience designing with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
* Familiarity with MIL\-STD\-461, MIL\-STD\-810, and MIL\-HDBK\-217 requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment


Preferred  




* M.S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline
* Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems
* Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support.

  

  

**Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position located at our Hyderabad office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.
* Overtime may be necessary to ensure the timely delivery of client projects.
* Weekend work is uncommon but may occasionally be required.


**Why join US?**


* Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

title: IP Admin Senior Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

**Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

**About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

**Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (8 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

title: TOC Network Operations Engineer (Analyst/Associate/AVP)
description:
**Why Mizuho** 




  





 At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.
 



  





 It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest—and growing—banks in the world.
 



  





 Mizuho Global Services (Pune) is establishing a state\-of\-the\-art Global Capability Center (GCC) in Pune, powering the strategic expansion of Mizuho Americas Services’ IT operations. At the heart of this initiative is the creation of a next\-generation Technology Operations Center (TOC), modeled on a “mission control” concept delivering real\-time visibility, proactive incident management and intelligent automation across critical infrastructure and applications. The Pune GCC will not only drive operational excellence but also act as a hub for innovation, transformation, and continuous improvement in Mizuho’s technology landscape.
 ***You will be joining one of the most advanced technology command center teams, helping to build and execute critical 24 x 7 operations for a major Investment Bank.***




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* You will be in the Network Operations mission specialist seat in the Technology Operations Center, leading the Level 1 support for service alerts and incidents on Mizuho Americas’ global network.
* You will work a rotating 24 x 7 x 365 shift pattern, completing 5 x 9\-hour shifts a week, including all three shifts: Shift 1 (Early), Shift 2 (Late), and Shift 3 (Overnight) on all 7 days of the week. Example:
* Weeks 1–4: Early
* Weeks 5–8: Late
* Weeks 9–12: Overnight
* You will demonstrate excellent operational discipline: strong focus on timeliness and professionalism, concentration, adherence to all runbooks and procedures, handling alerts and incidents in your mission specialist area.
* You will be a good problem solver. This role is about handling alerts, working on incidents, and solving problems. This is a personal and team activity, where working with your colleagues is critical to your success.
* You will be aligned with the respective US Infrastructure senior operations teams, for review and changes to runbooks, reviewing incidents, and learning new concepts.
* You will be a first responder for Network device and circuit incidents, with a goal to ensure rapid recovery and thorough handoff/root cause follow\-up.
* Your day\-to\-day delivery will be accurate, disciplined and professional: fast response to alerts and tickets, accurate selection and execution of runbooks, detailed and accurate notes added to each incident, clear shift handovers, and adherence to all policies and controls.
* You will mentor colleagues and juniors to you in a respectful manner, and you will be mentored by more senior colleagues. This is a continual learning environment where the desire to learn and the desire to share your knowledge is highly valued.
* You will suggest improvements in SLA adherence, incident reduction, MTTR (Mean Time to Resolve), and operational efficiency, based on your observations of service health and risks.
* You will demonstrate a level of technical understanding and troubleshooting according to your experience and target grade level, in the following areas:
* Enterprise networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing and switching concepts, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, load balancers, firewalls, and network monitoring tools
* Network topology and connectivity paths for critical business Applications and network services.
* Network availability and performance issues, such as packet loss, interface/route flapping, latency, jitter, DNS resolution failures, asymmetric routing, and firewall‑related connectivity problems, and determination of escalation paths.
* Routing protocols and enterprise network architecture concepts (e.g., BGP, OSPF, redundancy, high availability, and failover models).
* Error counters, SYSLOG, SNMP traps \& alarms.
* Carrier and circuit troubleshooting procedures, including checking of telecom circuit status, last‑mile issues, ISP handoffs, and coordination with service providers during outages.



  





**Mandatory Qualifications \& Experience:** 




  




* You
 
 must
 
 demonstrate career experience in Network Operations and support in a multinational company.
* You must be familiar with supporting a mix of network environments, including LAN, WAN, SD‑WAN, and cloud\-based networks.
* You
 
 must
 
 have troubleshooting skills in Networking, appropriate to your experience.
* Your grade will be determined based on your experience and level of expertise:
* **Analyst** 
 – you
 
 must
 
 have at least 1 year of hands\-on experience, including understanding the core concepts of your technical platform and area. You are demonstrating a hunger to learn and get qualifications, and you will be able to discuss some of the runbook procedures and incidents you have worked on.
* **Associate** 
 \- you
 
 must
 
 have at least 4 years of hands\-on experience, including installations, patching and upgrades, and a good understanding of common issues on your technical platform and area. You will ideally have professional qualifications in your area of expertise. You will be able to discuss a wide range of runbook procedures, and you will have good experience managing a wide range of incidents.
* **Assistant Vice President** 
 \- you
 
 must
 
 have at least 7 years of hands\-on experience, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of what it takes to support your technical platform and area. You
 
 must
 
 have a professional certification in your area of expertise. You
 
 must
 
 have experience of large\-scale major incidents and problem solving, and you
 
 must
 
 be able to discuss technical details of the installation, startup, running, patching and maintaining your technical platform.
* You
 
 must
 
 have excellent written and verbal English skills, to communicate on incident bridges with people locally and globally, read and write accurate incident reports, to perform formal shift handovers, and to learn from and train your colleagues.
* You
 
 must
 
 be reliable and dependable, attending the office in good time for your shift, and organizing your sleep patterns to be fully alert for each shift.
* You
 
 must
 
 be detail\-focused, and able to follow runbooks with a high level of accuracy.
* You
 
 must
 
 be a strong team\-worker, always willing to offer your opinion and participate in intense discussions to solve incidents, always respectful of all colleagues regardless of race, gender, religion, age, nationality, orientation, or other characteristics.



  





**Optional Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Work in a global banking or similarly regulated environment is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow and ITIL processes such as Incident, Problem, Change.
* Prior experience working in a 24x7x365 TOC/NOC/Command Center highly preferred.
* Familiarity with SolarWinds and ExtraHop highly preferred.



  





**Educational Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor of Engineering or a Degree in Computer Science is required.
* Networking industry certifications, with a focus on Cisco technologies (ACI experience preferred).



  





**Location:** 
 Pune, India
 



  





**Organization Overview:** 




  





 Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high\-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.
 



  





 MGS Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.
 



  





 MGS Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.
 



  





 MGS Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
 



  





 Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: ASIC Verification Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted \- SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare\-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic \& agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test\-frameworks team.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL\-simulations, c\-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
* You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
* The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re\-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
* You would assess and build C\-model or RTL\-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre\-silicon environment.


**What We Need To See**
* BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 0\-2 years of experience
* Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C\+\+, Python.
* Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
* Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt\-engines, CPU, boot\-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
* Operating System and Device\-Driver concepts and ability to write no\-OS test frameworks \- i.e tests that run directly on the bare\-metal SOC.
* A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
* Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.


**Way To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
* Exposure to Testbench architectures (C\+\+ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
* Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.


 With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; relevant certifications in programming or algorithms are an advantage.
* Prior experience training engineering or IT students or working professionals is preferred.

description:
**Position Title** Production Shift Supervisor

**Experience Fresher** (0 to 1 year max)

**Educational/Qualification B.E. / B.Tech (Chemical Engineering)** OR **M.Sc. (Organic/Analytical Chemistry)**

**Job Location** Plant Site (Sanand / Dhanot / Rajpur \- Gujarat)

**Shift Type** Rotational Shifts (including Night Shifts)

1\.Shift Operations \& Batch Monitoring

* Supervising day\-to\-day shop floor operations during the assigned shift to meet predefined production targets.
* Charging raw materials precisely as per the **Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR)** and operating instructions.
* Monitoring critical process parameters such as temperature, pressure, pH, and flow rates during unit operations (e.g., distillation, chlorination, condensation).
* Maintaining a thorough, real\-time record of production logs, BMRs, and shift handovers with zero discrepancies.

2\. Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) Compliance

* Ensuring strict adherence to **Work Permit Systems** (Cold Work, Hot Work, Height, Confined Space).
* Enforcing 100% compliance with Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) among all floor operators and contract workmen.
* Taking immediate corrective actions or reporting any gas leaks, chemical spillages, or near\-miss incidents to the Plant In\-charge.
* Participating in regular safety drills and maintaining a clean, hazard\-free work floor (5S methodology).

3\. Quality \& Troubleshooting

* In\-process sampling and coordinating with the Quality Control (QC) laboratory to ensure product parameters match strict specifications.
* Identifying raw material or process deviations early and escalating issues to the Production Manager to prevent batch failure.
* Ensuring the cleaning and sanitization of reactors, blenders, and pipelines during product changeovers.

4\. Workforce Management

* Directing and handling a team of operators and contract workers effectively to optimize labor productivity during the shift.
* Assisting in on\-the\-job training for floor personnel regarding safe chemical handling and process operations.

Required Skills and Competencies

* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong foundational understanding of chemical unit operations, mass balance, heat transfer, and basic equipment (reactors, distillation columns, centrifuges, pumps).
* **Communication:** Clear verbal and written skills to handle shift handovers, talk to plant heads, and manage shop floor workers.
* **Problem Solving:** Quick analytical skills to handle unexpected pressure or process changes during production.
* **Attitude:** A strong desire to learn, high integrity, and readiness to work in challenging, fast\-paced plant environments across rotational shifts.

description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join a team that is passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making and create custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in the growth, success, and well\-being of our people to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging, to managing critical emergencies. Together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, we are seeking a Scrum Master to support agile delivery teams building enterprise capabilities on
 **AWS cloud technologies** 
 and
 **TIMBR\-like tools** 
 . This role will help teams deliver platform, data, semantic, and context\-serving solutions efficiently by facilitating agile practices, removing impediments, and improving delivery flow across product, engineering, and architecture stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has experience supporting technical teams in complex enterprise environments and is comfortable working with cloud, data, and platform delivery teams. Familiarity with
 **data context, semantic systems, ontologies, agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 is preferred, as the teams may be delivering capabilities that support AI\-enabled and context\-driven use cases.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**What will you do**
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support one or more technical teams delivering capabilities in AWS and/or TIMBR\-like environments.
* Help teams maintain a healthy delivery cadence and improve predictability, transparency, and throughput.
* Remove or escalate impediments that slow team progress.
* Partner with product owners, technical leads, architects, and stakeholders to ensure priorities are clear and execution stays aligned.
* Track and communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Coach teams on agile principles, continuous improvement, and effective collaboration.
* Support coordination across teams when work spans APIs, pipelines, platform infrastructure, semantic models, or context\-serving services.
* Help teams manage dependencies and release coordination in complex enterprise settings.
* Encourage clear definition of done, story readiness, and cross\-functional alignment.
* Support delivery of work that may involve agentic AI workflows, prompt\-related capabilities, and context engineering needs.


**Required Qualifications**
**What should you have**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Delivery Lead, or similar role.
* Experience supporting technical teams in software, data, cloud, or platform environments.
* Strong facilitation, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with engineers, product managers, architects, and stakeholders.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud technologies and/or technical platform delivery environments.
* Comfort working in complex, cross\-functional enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with data context, semantic systems, ontology\-driven platforms, or TIMBR\-like tools is a plus.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts is preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting teams delivering APIs, data pipelines, platform services, or AI\-enabled products.
* Familiarity with agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Experience working with multiple teams and dependency\-heavy programs.
* Background in enterprise data, cloud, or semantic technology initiatives.
* Experience with release planning, program coordination, and delivery metrics.
* Agile certifications such as CSM, PSM, or equivalent are a plus.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role means
   

  

* the team has a healthy and predictable delivery cadence
* blockers are identified and removed quickly
* stakeholders have clear visibility into progress and risks
* cross\-team dependencies are managed effectively
* the team continuously improves its ways of working
* delivery supports stable progress toward AWS/TIMBR\-based platform goals

 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. **THE ROLE**

As an Application Support Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and availability of business\-critical web applications across global environments.

This is a customer\-facing support role that combines technical troubleshooting, application monitoring, and operational support. You will work closely with customers, development teams, and internal stakeholders to diagnose issues, resolve incidents, and maintain seamless application performance.
