description:
**Build Your Dreams at**
**Constelli.**
---------------------------------------


FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.


We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.

  


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:

* Software \- defined Radar simulators.
* Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
* Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
* Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.

Who Thrives Here
* Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
* Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
* Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
* Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.

What You’ll Experience
* End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
* Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
* Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.

  
**About Us**


We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting\-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission\-critical applications.


**About the role**


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail\-oriented V\&V (Verification \& Validation) Engineer – Senior to join our engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with cross\-functional development teams throughout the product lifecycle, contributing to test planning, validation strategies, troubleshooting support, and system\-level verification activities.


The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in test methodologies, automation frameworks, RF and digital test environments, and requirements\-based testing. The role also involves field testing, documentation, and supporting continuous integration workflows to ensure reliable and high\-quality product releases.



Key Responsibilities


* Develop comprehensive verification and validation plans for embedded, RF, and signal processing systems.
* Define acceptance criteria, test strategies, and requirements\-based validation methodologies.
* Collaborate closely with FPGA, software, hardware, and system engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Python and related tools.
* Perform RF and digital hardware testing using lab equipment and automated test setups.
* Support Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) testing environments.
* Plan and execute field testing activities for SIGINT and related systems.
* Analyze system failures, assist in troubleshooting, and provide validation insights to development teams.
* Maintain regression testing workflows for software and FPGA releases where applicable.
* Generate and maintain technical documentation, test reports, validation records, and compliance documentation.
* Support CI/CD and automated test execution using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools.
* Ensure adherence to applicable testing standards and internal quality processes.

  

Required Qualifications


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electronics \& Communication, Embedded Systems, Instrumentation, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 4\+ years of experience in Verification \& Validation, System Testing, or Integration Testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python with experience in automation frameworks such as PyVISA and pytest.
* Experience working with RF and digital test equipment and automated measurement setups.
* Good understanding of Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) frameworks.
* Experience in test planning, test case development, and requirements\-based testing.
* Familiarity with Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar CI/CD tools.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in technical documentation and reporting using LaTeX, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of FPGA validation and automated regression testing is an added advantage.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work in cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel for field trials and on\-site testing activities when required.

  


**EMPLOYEE STATUS AND COMMITMENTS**


* Permanent full\-time position based at our Hyderabad office.
* Involvement in on\-site integration, customer demonstrations, and field trials as required.
* Opportunity to work on advanced Defence and Aerospace signal processing systems.


**Why join US?**


* Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protecting in the building sector and motor vehicle industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 101 countries around the world and manufactures in over 300 factories. Its more than 27,500 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11\.20 billion in 2025\.

 **Job Description** **Title :** Factory Manager

**Department :** Operations

**Location :** Bagru, Jaipur

**Reports To :** Lead Manufacturing Cluster North \& Toll

***Overview***


To be responsible for leading operations of our factory at Bagru Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Growth, legal compliances, capacity enhancement and maintenance.

***Roles and Responsibilities****:*


1\.Manufacturing quality products as per schedule.


2\.Delivery of goods as per time scheduled by the customer.


3\. Maintain standards of 5S and Housekeeping throughout the factory.


4\.Complete compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements and ensure effective relation building with Government officers / departments.


5\. Maintain EHS, ISO\-9001:2000 and other related quality systems as per existing norms. Fully compliance with Pollution control norms and well aware about pollution norms, ETP, STP and water treatment.


6\.Inspire leadership, maintain positive discipline and foster harmonious industrial relations among management, staff and workmen.


7\.Recruit, train and retain a strong team for successful unit operation.


8\.Reduce unit overhead cost through Direct Labour, expenses, Productivity, effective process flow etc. Managing factory Budget and ensure monthly reporting the same.


9\. Cycle counts and physical verification process and take factory inventory visibility to organization.


10\. Good understanding of equipment, engineering process, productivity KPI and projects for running a sizable formulation plant.

 **INTER\-DEPARTMENTAL RELATIONSHIPS:**


Internal : Please include QC, Technology, EHS, projects, Supply Chain Management dept.


External : Please include vendors, service providers (labour, logistics...etc.) for Bagru factory,

 **KEY SKILLS REQUIRED**

* Good Chemical process knowledge of Construction Chemical, paint industry, powder and liquid blending through HMI and SCADA process automation.
* Good knowledge on packing machines of powder lines, liquid and viscous products.
* Good supervisory skills with capability of handling Company employees and contractors.
* Experience of retail, distribution and direct business product manufacturing exposure. Handling 300\+ finish goods SKUs and more than 1000 RM/PM exposure is desired.
* Problem solving and analytical abilities. Solution provider and positive attitude.
* Good English written and oral Communication. Good inter personnel skills and the ability to inspire and build a strong team.
* Good Coach and mentor.
* Integrity and honesty and able to foster it in team.
* Good production planning capability along with hands on experience with shift management. Handling Production activities, bringing improvements in Productivity and providing guidance to the manufacturing unit in production planning, Inventory Control, excellent managerial abilities.
* Resource organizing and networking capability.
* Hands on financial and factory cost understanding
* Hands on experience on SAP production module
* Basic knowledge of HR / IR requirements or experience
* Basic shopfloor safety knowledge \& experience
* Eye for operation excellence

 **Qualifications \& Experience:**


 BE/BTech: Chemical or Mechanical. 10 to 14 years exp in Manufacturing.

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. ===================================================

**Location: Vijayawada**

**1\. Job Purpose**
-------------------


The Regional Manager – Gold Loans is responsible for driving business growth, portfolio quality, profitability, operational excellence, and risk management across the designated region. The role ensures achievement of disbursement, revenue, collection, and customer acquisition targets while maintaining strict adherence to gold valuation standards, regulatory requirements, audit controls, and asset safety protocols. The incumbent will lead Area Heads/Branch Managers to build a high\-performance sales and service culture.

* Drive customer acquisition and market expansion across the region.

* Drive repeat business and customer engagement initiatives.

* Oversee adherence to valuation, LTV norms, documentation, and approval processes.
* Ensure quality sourcing and profitable portfolio growth.

### **Compliance of Regulatory Guidelines**

* Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines, company policies, audit requirements, and gold custody standards.

### **Portfolio Monitoring**

* Monitor portfolio growth, delinquency, auction performance, risk indicators, and branch profitability.

**3\. Job Context \& Major Challenges**
---------------------------------------

Gold Loans is a strategically important secured lending business requiring rapid turnaround, high customer trust, stringent risk controls, and efficient branch operations. The Regional Manager is accountable for balancing aggressive growth objectives with strong governance and risk management practices. \[JD \- Manag...Valuation \| Word]

### **Job Context**


The role oversees multiple Area Heads and Branch Managers across the region and ensures:

* Achievement of business targets and profitability.
* Adherence to approved valuation and operational standards.
* Prevention of spurious, counterfeit, and bentex gold incidents.
* Effective collection management and controlled NPAs.
* Strong audit and compliance scores across branches.
* Talent development and succession planning.

### **Key Challenges**

* Managing rapid business growth while maintaining portfolio quality.
* Driving productivity across geographically dispersed branches.
* Ensuring consistent valuation and risk practices.
* Managing collections and auctions in competitive markets.
* Building and retaining capable branch leadership teams.
* Maintaining customer experience while ensuring compliance.

Gold Valuation Governance Ensure adherence to valuation SOPs, purity testing standards and LTV norms across all branches.  


Risk \& Compliance Management Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines, internal audits, surprise checks and operational controls.  


Collections \& Auction Management Drive collection efficiency, overdue recovery and auction processes within policy guidelines.  


Profitability \& Productivity Improve branch productivity, operating efficiency and profitability metrics.  


Team Leadership \& Talent Development Recruit, coach and develop Area Heads, Branch Managers and key talent across the region.  


Customer Experience Enhance service quality, complaint resolution and customer retention.  


Business Reviews \& Reporting Conduct regular business reviews, MIS analysis and action planning for performance improvement.  

**5\. Job Purpose of Direct Reports**
-------------------------------------

### **Area Head – Gold Loans**

* Responsible for achieving business, portfolio, and profitability targets within the assigned territory.
* Manage Branch Managers and ensure adherence to operational, valuation, and compliance standards.

### **Branch Manager – Gold Loans**

* Drive branch business, customer acquisition, collections, and operational controls.
* Ensure proper execution of gold valuation, documentation, and customer service processes.

---------------------

**Relationship** **Frequency** **Nature**  


Area Heads Daily Business reviews, performance tracking, target achievement and governance.  


Branch Managers Daily Operational management, business planning and compliance monitoring.

Operations Team Daily Process adherence, customer service and operational support.  


HR Team Monthly Hiring, manpower planning and talent development.  


Customers Need Based Relationship management and grievance resolution.  


External Agencies / Vendors Need Based Security, auction, valuation and branch infrastructure support.

--------------------

### **Functional Competencies**

* Gold Loan Business Management
* Lending \& Credit Fundamentals
* Portfolio Risk Management
* Collections \& Recovery Management
* Regulatory Compliance
* Branch Operations Management
* MIS \& Business Analytics

### **Behavioral Competencies**

* Leadership \& Team Management
* Customer Centricity
* Execution Excellence
* Strategic Thinking
* Decision Making
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving

### **Preferred Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience in Gold Loans, Retail Assets, NBFC, Banking or Secured Lending.
* Minimum 3–5 years in managing multi\-branch/multi\-state operations.
* Proven track record in business growth, collections, and team leadership.

title: Front End Developer
description:
**About the Opportunity**

Frontend is not a support function at Gracia. It is central to how we design and ship products, and we are scaling that capability.

We are looking for a **UI/UX \& Frontend Developer – Figma, React, Flutter \& Full Stack** who can take a product idea, design it in Figma, and then build it into a production\-grade web or mobile application without hand\-holding at any stage. This is an end\-to\-end ownership role. You will design the interface, translate it into working code, integrate it with backend systems, and ship features that actually work, not just visually but functionally, for the business using them.

If you can design a clean, usable interface in Figma and then build it yourself in React and Flutter and want to grow inside a firm building real fintech products alongside its consulting practice, this role is for you.

**What You Will Do**

*UI/UX Design in Figma*  
Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI screens in Figma for web and mobile applications. Own the design process from concept to design system, layouts, components, spacing, states, and interactions, before a single line of code is written.

*Figma\-to\-Code Implementation*  
Convert your own (or existing) Figma UI designs into pixel\-accurate, responsive React (web) and Flutter (mobile) code. You own the full translation from design to functioning interface.

*Full Stack Web Application Development*  
Build and maintain web applications end\-to\-end, frontend components, API integration, state management, and where needed, backend/API work to support the features you're building.

*Cross\-Platform Mobile Development*  
Develop and maintain Flutter applications for iOS and Android from a single codebase, ensuring consistent behaviour and performance across platforms.

*Design System \& Component Architecture*  
Build and maintain a reusable design system in Figma, and mirror it in code through reusable, maintainable component libraries, so new screens and features can be designed and built faster without duplicating work.

*API Integration \& Data Flow*  
Integrate frontend applications with REST/GraphQL APIs, third\-party services, and internal systems (including Zoho and FinBowl/PEMS). Understand how data moves through the application, not just how to display it.

*Performance \& Quality*  
Optimise for load time, responsiveness, and smooth interactions. Write code that is testable, debuggable, and doesn't break under real\-world use.

*Collaboration with Product \& Stakeholders*  
Work closely with product owners and, where relevant, clients, to understand what's needed, design it, validate it, and then build it, closing the loop yourself instead of handing off between design and dev.

*Deployment \& Handover*  
Ship features to production, document your work, and ensure both the Figma files and codebase remain understandable and maintainable for whoever touches them next.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong working knowledge of **Figma** — wireframing, prototyping, component\-based design systems, and handoff\-ready files.
* Strong working knowledge of **React** (hooks, state management, component design) and **Flutter/Dart** for cross\-platform mobile development.
* Proven ability to take a product requirement, design it in Figma, and then build it into responsive, accurate frontend code, end to end, without significant rework.
* Full stack comfort — you can work with APIs, basic backend logic, and databases, even if your primary strength is frontend and design.
* Understanding of **REST/GraphQL APIs**, authentication flows, and state management patterns (Redux, Zustand, Riverpod, Provider, or similar).
* Strong eye for **UI/UX fundamentals** — visual hierarchy, spacing, usability, and consistent interaction patterns.
* Automation and tooling mindset — comfortable with Git, CI/CD basics, and writing code that scales beyond a single feature.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll work directly with product owners, and occasionally clients.
* Experience with mobile app store deployment (Play Store/App Store) is a plus.
* Prior experience designing and building fintech, CRM, or ERP\-adjacent applications is a strong advantage.

**Who Should Apply**

Candidates with **1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience** in UI/UX design (Figma) combined with React and Flutter development. Freshers with an exceptional portfolio (Figma designs paired with shipped code) and strong communication skills will also be considered. Must be based in Mumbai or willing to relocate.

**Location:** Mumbai, India  
**Role Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 years (exceptional freshers welcome)

Gracia Global Advisory LLP is an ISO 9001:2015\-certified firm, a Zoho Finance Advanced Partner, and a member of the World Trade Center Mumbai and the Indo\-American Chamber of Commerce.

With our team of 1800\+ professionals, we deliver superior value across the areas of Supply chain (SC) , Digital \& Technology (D\&T) Innovation, Technology \& Quality (ITQ), Consumer and Market Intelligence (CMI), Sales Strategy \& Intelligence (SSI) , Global Shared Services (GSS) , Finance Shared Services (FSS) and Human Resources Shared Services (HRSS).For more details check out https://www.generalmills.co.in  

We advocate for advancing equity and inclusion to create more equitable workplaces and a better tomorrow. **Job Overview** **Function Overview**
The GIC Supply Chain team manages end\-to\-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well\-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions.
For more details about the Function please visit this Link **Purpose of the role**
To support and enhance supply planning activities for finished and semi\-finished products within the Global Planning Hub. The role aims to sustain and continuously improve supply planning capabilities by evaluating their impact on key business KPIs. It involves close collaboration with regional planning teams and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to drive consistency, efficiency, and performance across global supply planning processes. **Key Accountabilities**  

Supply Planning Execution \& Data Management:* Analyze and maintain supply planning data with end\-to\-end ownership over OMP\-based planning data, and stewardship of non\-OMP planning data in collaboration with GIC counterparts.
* Ensure timely and accurate replenishment of stock from plants to origin warehouses based on demand signals in OMP.
* Manage and support FINI (Finished Goods) Product Lifecycle Planning inputs for effective transitions and phase\-outs.
* Validate and troubleshoot input data/attributes influencing solver outputs, reports, and planning scenarios.


 Solver Optimization \& Inventory Management:* Implement and maintain supply chain optimization policies within the OMP Solver environment.
* Troubleshoot solver\-related issues in collaboration with Concurrent Supply Planners (CSP’s) and finite schedulers to ensure planning accuracy.
* Support long\-range inventory planning and align inventory strategies across regional teams.


Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement:* Monitor and analyze supply planning KPIs to provide actionable insights and highlight areas for improvement.
* Generate reports and dashboards to provide visibility of performance metrics and planning effectiveness.
* Identify gaps or inefficiencies in supply planning processes and propose data\-driven solutions to enhance performance.


Compliance \& Governance:* Collaborate with supply chain teams to ensure compliance with SLA requirements related to planning parameters and strategies.
* Validate system\-driven outputs and ensure consistency with defined planning policies and procedures.


Stakeholder Collaboration:* Provide analytical support to COE supply planning leads, concurrent planners, plant planners, and regional material planners.
* Build and maintain strong cross\-functional relationships to promote collaboration, alignment, and continuous improvement across planning teams.

**Minimum Qualifications*** Education – Full time graduation from an accredited university.
* 3 years of related experience.
* 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in supply planning, inventory management, or basic supply chain operations.
* Sound understanding of logistics and end\-to\-end supply chain processes.
* Familiarity with industry practices, business dynamics, and operational nuances.
* Knowledge of supply planning tools and systems.
* Ability to process and evaluate large data sets.
* Usage of data process and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational and multitasking capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Preferred Degree Requirements: Masters.
* Preferred Major Area of Study: Operations / Supply Chain.

title: HR Manager
description:
Looking for an experienced HR Generalist – Manager to lead end\-to\-end HR operations with a strong emphasis on payroll processing, statutory compliance, and HRIS management. This role is ideal for a hands\-on HR professional who combines generalist breadth (employee lifecycle, policy, employee relations) with deep expertise in payroll accuracy, labour law compliance, and HR systems — particularly GreytHR.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Management:

* Own end\-to\-end monthly payroll processing for all employees, ensuring 100% accuracy and timeliness.
* Manage payroll inputs — new joiners, exits, salary revisions, attendance, leave, reimbursements, loans/advances, one time payments, and full \& final settlements.
* Reconcile payroll data with finance/accounts before disbursement; coordinate bank file uploads and salary disbursal.
* Generate and distribute payslips, Form 16, and other payroll\-related documents.
* Handle payroll\-related employee queries and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance:

* Ensure full compliance with PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, Gratuity, and Bonus Act requirements.
* Manage timely statutory filings, challans, and returns (PF/ESI/PT monthly \& annual returns).
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws, Shops \& Establishment Act, and applicable state/central regulations; assess and implement impact on policies and payroll. Liaise with auditors, statutory bodies, and consultants for audits, inspections, and assessments.
* Maintain compliance trackers/dashboards and ensure zero\-default status across all statutory obligations.
* Ensure proper documentation and record\-keeping for compliance audits (internal and external).

HRIS / GreytHR Management:

* Serve as the primary system owner/admin for GreytHR (or equivalent HRMS) — data accuracy and process flow.
* Manage employee master data, attendance, leave, and payroll modules within the system.
* Generate HR MIS reports, payroll reports, and compliance reports from GreytHR for management review.
* Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate with the vendor for upgrades, integrations, or fixes.
* Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual intervention in payroll and compliance workflows.

HR Generalist Responsibilities:

* Manage the employee lifecycle: onboarding, confirmation, transfers, exits, and full \& final settlement.
* Draft, update, and implement HR policies in line with statutory and organizational requirements.
* Support employee relations — grievance handling, disciplinary processes, and policy clarifications.
* Coordinate performance management cycles, including data tracking and reporting.
* Partner with Finance on cost\-to\-company (CTC) structuring, budgeting, and payroll cost analysis.
* Support internal/external HR audits and ensure documentation readiness at all times.

Experience: 3–5 years in HR Generalist roles, with at least 1–2 years focused on payroll and statutory compliance.

**Technical Skills: Strong working knowledge of GreytHR (payroll, attendance, leave, and reporting modules) — mandatory.** 

**◦ Proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, payroll reconciliation). ◦ Familiarity with other HRMS/payroll tools is a plus.** 

Compliance Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Gratuity, Bonus Act, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other applicable labour laws.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience using GreytHR?

Work Location: In person

As Engineering Manager, you will manage a cross\-functional team of engineers implementing the content strategy for Booking.com, leading the transition of these foundations into an AI\-native model where copy agents generate copy and translations at design and code time, QA runs continuously, and changes ship and are tested across markets at once, cutting time\-to\-market and cost. You will own the guardrails that keep this trustworthy, including governance and compliance, accuracy, brand consistency, and robust evaluation of agent output. Success depends on aligning a complex set of stakeholders, from UX writers, designers, product, and engineering to localization, experimentation, legal, and senior leadership.

 **Key Job Responsibilities and Duties**


As a **Software Engineering Manager** you are responsible for managing a team of engineers and working closely with product and tech stakeholders across the track and area to ensure timely and quality delivery of the roadmap.


Important aspects of the job include:

* Inspire and develop individuals by helping create personal development plans, leveraging learning resources, and offering stretch opportunities for growth.  

Manage performance effectively by setting and reviewing clear objectives and KPIs, providing timely feedback, and collaborating closely with HR counterparts when needed.
* Ensure delivery through ownership by being proactive, collaborating with peers and stakeholders, tracking roadmap progress, and resolving or escalating blockers.
* Manage team stakeholders by clearly and regularly reporting progress and blockers to ensure transparency and alignment.  

Support recruitment and planning by participating in headcount planning and involving your team in hiring processes.
* Coach and mentor colleagues across levels by sharing your experience, knowledge, and approaches to work to improve overall performance.
* Own systems end to end by monitoring application health and performance, setting and responding to relevant metrics, and guiding junior team members in these practices.  

Reduce operational risk by applying state\-of\-the\-art tools and practices, maintaining clear documentation (e.g. runbooks, OpDocs), and improving business continuity and the bus factor.
* Improve system reliability by addressing live production issues within SLA, contributing to root cause analysis, and logging and learning from incidents via postmortems.
* Build high\-quality software by applying relevant development languages, using standard libraries and design patterns, and following testing strategies that ensure security, integrity, and quality.
* Guide architectural decisions by advising on technical solutions that meet functional and non\-functional requirements, and aligning improvements with the wider architectural landscape.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying and implementing improvements in processes, systems, and structures, and by applying critical thinking to evaluate and develop ideas.

 **Role Qualifications and Requirements**

**Must\-Haves:**

* 8\+ years of experience in building enterprise software products. Previous experience as a developer will be preferred
* 1\+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager (must be a dedicated management role, not a temporary caretaking assignment).
* Ability to read and understand code and apply simple design patterns to refactor code and ensure quality standard by applying testing strategies
* Maintain data security, integrity and quality by following company standards, best practices and relevant legislation.
* Ability to evaluate possible architecture solutions by taking into account the cost, business requirements, technology requirements and emerging technologies.
* Ability to describe the implications for changing an existing system or adding a new system to a specific area, by having a broad, high\-level understanding of the infrastructure and architecture of our systems.
* Ability to help grow the business and/or accelerate software development by applying engineering techniques (e.g. prototyping, spiking and vendor evaluation) and Bookings technical standards.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
About HireRight:

We empower organizations around the world to hire with precision and act with confidence. As a global leader in background screening and workforce intelligence, we combine smart technology, human expertise, and a passion for delivering speed and accuracy to create a seamless experience for both employers and candidates. Headquartered in Nashville, TN, and operating in over 200 countries and territories, we’re proud to help millions of people get hired — the right way.


Overview:

We are seeking a high‑impact Senior HR Business Partner who is not only a strategic thought partner but also exceptionally strong with numbers, analytics, and business insights. This individual will play a critical role in shaping people strategy in India, driving organizational transformation, and enabling business performance across global teams.

  

The ideal candidate is business‑savvy, highly analytical, action‑oriented, comfortable making decisions, and skilled at navigating complex stakeholder relationships while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.


Responsibilities:
**Key Outcomes**

* **Strategic \& Analytical Impact:** HR strategies informed by deep data insights and business metrics, resulting in measurable improvements in productivity, talent health, and organizational performance.
* **Leadership Influence:** Strong advisory capabilities with senior leaders, backed by clear data storytelling and evidence‑based recommendations.
* **Change Leadership:** Successful execution of organizational change initiatives with agility, clarity, and stakeholder alignment.
* **Operational Excellence:** High‑quality delivery of global HR programs with local relevance – on time, with discipline, and with a focus on measurable outcomes.
* **Employee Experience:** Strengthened engagement and improved retention through proactive interventions grounded in data and business acumen.

 **Core Competencies**

* **Ownership \& Accountability:** Critical for the role
* **Employee Relations \& Employment Law Acumen:** Demonstrates strong working knowledge of local labour laws and applies it to manage complex ER matters
* **Business Acumen \& Financial Understanding** – Connects business metrics (revenue, productivity, cost drivers) with people strategies; translates data into actionable decisions.
* **Data\-Driven Decision Making** – Strong ability to analyze workforce data, identify trends, diagnose issues, and propose data‑backed recommendations.
* **Influencing \& Stakeholder Management** – Builds trust, manages senior stakeholders effectively, and drives alignment across global teams.
* **Change Leadership** – Leads transformation initiatives with clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes.
* **Execution \& Action Orientation** – Moves quickly from insight to action, makes informed decisions, and manages multiple projects with precision.
* **Cultural Intelligence** – Navigates global and local cultural nuances to design inclusive and impactful HR solutions.
* **Prioritization \& Multitasking** – Manages high volumes of work and parallel projects without compromising quality.

  


Qualifications: **Experience \& Knowledge**

* Proven experience as an Senior HR Business Partner in a global matrix environment.
* Hands‑on experience in talent management, workforce planning, organizational design, performance management, and change management.
* Demonstrated ability to use analytics, dashboards, and data tools to diagnose challenges and influence decisions.
* Strong understanding of global HR practices, local compliance, and evolving workforce trends.

 **Measures of Success**

* + Improvement in business performance indicators tied to HR interventions.
	+ Strong leadership advocacy and trust reflected through feedback and collaboration outcomes.
	+ Increased employee sentiment, stronger inclusion markers, and reduced regrettable attrition.
	+ Effective local deployment of global HR initiatives with minimal rework and strong stakeholder alignment.
	+ Timely delivery and quality of multiple HR projects and priorities.
	+ Demonstrated ability to make fast, informed decisions with clear rationale.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

* + 5\+ years of progressive HR experience in a global or matrixed HRBP role.
	+ Strong numerical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills; ability to interpret and act on data.
	+ Proven capability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
	+ Experience in organizational design, talent management, and leading change.
	+ Excellent communication skills, including data‑backed storytelling.
	+ Ability to operate in a fast‑moving, deadline‑driven environment while managing multiple priorities.
	+ High degree of ownership, decision‑making ability, and action orientation.


What do we offer:

Please submit resume/CV in English.  

All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.  

  

HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

description:
#### **About the Team**



Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.


#### **About the Role**



We are seeking an experienced Manager – HR Operations \& HR Systems to lead and manage HR operations while ensuring the smooth functioning of HR systems. This role involves overseeing the day\-to\-day HR processes, ensuring data accuracy and integrity within HR systems, and implementing process improvements. The successful candidate will act as a key liaison between HR, IT, and other departments to support HR digitalization, optimize operational efficiencies, and drive impactful HR initiatives.



### **What you will do**


### **1\. Employee Lifecycle Management**


* Own and lead end\-to\-end employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee movements, confirmations, transfers, promotions, compensation changes, benefits administration, leave \& attendance, separations, and offboarding.
* Ensure seamless, consistent, and high\-quality employee experiences across all people processes.
* Establish and continuously improve standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to deliver operational excellence.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, IT, Legal, and Business Leaders to ensure efficient delivery of People Operations.
* Ensure timely issuance and maintenance of employment documentation, contracts, letters, statutory records, and employee records.

### **2\. People Operations Governance**


* Drive operational governance by establishing service standards, SLAs, quality controls, and compliance mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, labor laws, statutory regulations, and audit requirements across all HR operations.
* Own policy implementation and operational compliance while ensuring process consistency across the organization.
* Lead internal and external audits related to employee records, HR operations, and statutory compliance.

### **3\. HR Systems \& Digital Operations**


* Own the operational effectiveness of the organization's HR technology ecosystem, including HRMS, Payroll, Attendance, Performance Management, Learning, Survey, and other People systems.
* Partner with HR Systems and IT teams to support system implementations, enhancements, testing, integrations, and process optimization.
* Drive system adoption, data accuracy, and continuous improvements across HR platforms.
* Leverage technology to simplify employee transactions and improve operational efficiency.

### **4\. Process Excellence \& Automation**


* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to simplify, standardize, and automate People Operations processes.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and employee experience.
* Drive digital transformation initiatives by reducing manual interventions and increasing self\-service capabilities.
* Establish operational metrics and continuously improve turnaround times and service quality.

### **5\. HR Analytics \& Operational Insights**


* Own People Operations dashboards and reporting across employee lifecycle metrics, workforce movements, service delivery, compliance, and operational performance.
* Generate actionable insights to support workforce planning and strategic decision\-making.
* Monitor operational KPIs, identify trends, and recommend process improvements.
* Present periodic operational reviews and governance updates to HR and business leadership.

### **6\. Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**


* Build strong partnerships with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, IT, Information Security, Legal, and external vendors to ensure seamless delivery of People Operations.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex employee lifecycle and operational issues.
* Influence stakeholders to adopt standardized processes and continuously improve service delivery.

### **7\. Team Leadership**


* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing People Operations team.
* Establish clear goals, performance expectations, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, customer\-centricity, and operational excellence.
* Build capability within the team through coaching, knowledge sharing, and process documentation.
### **What you will need**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree or MBA in HR is preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in HR Operations or People Operations, with proven experience managing end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience leading People Operations teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth organizations.

description:
**Why this role exists**


This role exists to build early\-career talent in Light Gauge Steel Framing, BIM/VDC, prefabrication, and construction technology workflows. The role is designed for freshers who are eager to learn how digital models, drawings, coordination processes, and fabrication\-ready deliverables support real construction projects.


When this role is performed well, freshers develop strong technical foundations, contribute to accurate project deliverables, support senior team members effectively, and gradually grow into independent project contributors. This role helps create a pipeline of skilled engineers who can support scalable, quality\-driven delivery across LGSF and prefab\-focused projects.

**What You Will Learn and Support**

**Project Delivery and Modeling Support**

* Support the development of accurate 3D models for Light Gauge Steel Framing using Revit, MWF/Tekla, or similar tools.
* Assist in preparing model views, shop drawings, basic schedules, and project documentation under guidance from team members.
* Learn to read architectural, structural, and engineering drawings to understand project scope and modeling requirements.
* Support project setup activities such as file organization, view creation, model cleanup, and documentation control.
* Assist in updating models and drawings based on comments, markups, RFIs, and coordination inputs.

**Coordination and Communication**

* Participate in internal coordination discussions to understand project priorities, design intent, and delivery expectations.
* Coordinate with team members to resolve basic modeling or documentation issues.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly to project leads/coaches.
* Learn how BIM/VDC models support downstream teams such as fabrication, procurement, and field execution.
* Develop confidence in professional communication through project reviews and team interactions.

**Process Learning and Technical Growth**

* Learn standard BIM workflows, naming conventions, modeling standards, and quality requirements.
* Follow established SOPs, templates, and checklists to maintain consistency in deliverables.
* Explore tools such as Revit, Navisworks, ACC/Forma, Bluebeam, MWF, Tekla, Vertex BD, Dynamo, or similar platforms.
* Support basic quality checks by reviewing model accuracy, drawing completeness, and adherence to project standards.
* Build awareness of automation, data\-driven workflows, and emerging construction technologies.

**Team Collaboration and Ownership**

* Work closely with engineers and project teams to complete assigned tasks on time.
* Be open to feedback and actively improve modeling, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Maintain accountability for assigned work and ask questions early when information is unclear.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment by sharing learnings and supporting peers.
* Demonstrate curiosity, discipline, and a willingness to learn new tools and construction workflows.

**A day in this role**


The day starts by reviewing assigned tasks, project priorities, and guidance from senior team members. You work on model development, drawing updates, documentation tasks, or markups while checking project standards and references. You coordinate with teammates to clarify requirements and resolve basic issues. Time is spent learning software tools, understanding LGSF systems, reviewing drawing sets, and incorporating feedback into deliverables. As you grow, you begin supporting quality checks, coordination preparation, and workflow improvements. The day closes with progress updates, documenting open questions, and preparing the next set of project tasks.

description:
**Eurofins Scientific** 
 is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
   

  





 The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.
   

  





  

  





 In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
   

  





  

  





 In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:
   

  

 As part of the Security Intelligence team, you will be assessing and reducing threats to Eurofins.
   

  

 You will be responsible for tracking targeted campaigns and threat actors, analyzing intrusions, utilizing data gathered through incident response, discovering our threat surface, and analyzing and translating threats to Eurofins’ infrastructure and leveraging intelligence to improve the security posture.
   

  

  

  

 POSITION \& OBJECTIVES:
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 • Proactively identify and track targeted intrusion cyber threats, trends and new developments by adversaries throughout multiple regions by analysis of raw intelligence and data.
   

  

 • Conduct thorough analysis of threat data from various sources, including open\-source intelligence (OSINT), dark web monitoring and proprietary threat feeds.
   

  

 • Apply analytic best practices and tradecraft to gathered intelligence in a consistent manner.
   

  

 • Provide finished intelligence analysis assessments to internal stakeholders through written reporting with minimal supervision.
   

  

 • Identify intelligence gaps and submit requests for information to fill gaps.
   

  

 • Provide peer review of proposed/draft reporting and analytic uplift to team members.
   

  

 • Prioritize, categorize and respond to requests for information from internal stakeholders.
   

  

 • Assist in the development and enhancement of threat intelligence tools and processes.
   

  

 • Work closely with incident response, threat hunting, vulnerability management and security operations teams to provide intelligence support during security incidents.
   

  

 Technical Knowledge:
   

  

 • Familiarity with Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs) and tools.
   

  

 • Proficiency in analyzing malware and vulnerabilities.
   

  

 • Knowledge in any of scripting languages like Python, Bash Scripts, PowerShell (Nice to have).
   

  

 • Hands\-on Experience with setup, configuration, integration of MISP and leveraging the tool to enhance Security Intelligence in Eurofins with different playbooks created in SOAR platform.
   

  

 • Understanding of technical terminology, tools and tactics employed by threat actors.
   

  

 • Ability or willingness to learn to conduct technical analysis of the tools and tradecraft used by threat actors.
   

  

 • Good knowledge of MITRE ATT\&ck framework and known APT groups activity
   

  

 Personal Qualities:
   

  

 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (concise writing and oral convincing);
   

  

 • Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities.
   

  

 • Excellent interpersonal, analytical, detail\-oriented, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 • Proactive personality who can adapt to changing priorities and a keen analytical mindset to investigate cases.
   

  

 • Good team player with ability to work with team spread across the world.
   

  

  

  

 What we offer:
   

  

 • Opportunity to grow in a demanding, fast\-growing organization.
   

  

 • Very attractive, multicultural and friendly work environment in fast\-growing international company (more than 65 000 employees now)
   

  

 • Possibility to grow and make the next step in your professional career and self\-development.
   

  

 • A launch pad into various opportunities – within many business lines of Eurofins globally
   

  

 • A chance to become part of a highly motivated international team of professionals.
   

  

  

  

  

  

 QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
   

  

 • BE/B.Tech/MCA or any other equivalent degree.
   

  

 • 2\+ years’ experience in Security / Threat Intelligence role.
   

  

 • 5 years of incremental experience in the areas of Cybersecurity.

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**


You are part of a team in India responsible for building sustainable cocoa sourcing strategies to meet Cocoa\-Life objectives on best practices in sustainable cocoa farming, improving livelihoods in cocoa communities, protecting the forest and the environment, and building and maintaining Mondelēz International’s reputation.


**How you will contribute**


You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management of the nursery, ensuring that processes are strictly followed and that the Cocoa nursery is well\-tended and respected. In addition, you will:


* Work with government officials in horticulture and agriculture departments to implement cocoa programs.
* Collect data for crop forecasting and market intelligence for pricing decisions.
* Work with third\-party operations for cocoa procurement and processing.

**What you will bring**


A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career with experience and knowledge in:


* Strong analytics and process discipline
* Hands\-on knowledge of agriculture with a commercial orientation
* Communication, with strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Ability to work alone and independently without direct supervision

**More about this role \-**

The resource should be good at Agronomy, Horticulture, Farmer training and extensive field visits, Nursery management, networking with farming \& rural communities. The resource should be a committed team person building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The person should be committed towards fulfilling Mondelez's policies and compliance requirements and implement Cocoa Life initiatives towards achieving economic, social, and environmental sustainability.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* **Cocoa Area development** – Farmer identification and new area identification
* **Cocoa Crop Science** – Nursery Management, P\&D management, Agronomy, Extension and farmer retention
* **Cocoa Procurement** – Coordinate with third\-party buying partners who operate on a commission\-per\-kilo basis. Receive and account for cocoa deliveries at collection sites. Monitor quality of beans purchased against specific quality requirements. Manage documentation and dispatch of beans to factory. Effectively train farmers on Post\-Harvest and Quality management.
* **Cocoa Life Program** – Involve in Cocoa Life programs like Community Development Programs through NGO partnerships, Young Farm Survey, Agro\-forestry, CSR and Sustainability program Mondelez International Internal
* **People management** – Cocoa Nursery and TPO collection staff, workers education on quality requirement.
* **Research \& Institutional Collaboration** – Support research projects with institutions such as Kerala Agriculture University and CPCRI. Assist senior staff on research and project\-related activities.
* **Government \& Stakeholder Liaison** – Liaise with local government officials, Horticulture and Agriculture Departments at village level. Coordinate with Govt depts including FSSAI and other licenses as required.
* Implementing Sustainability and Safety Initiatives.
* **Digital Onboarding** of Farmers, Polygon mapping of Farms and Digital tools for procurement

**Education / Certifications:**

* BSc. Agriculture/ Horticulture/Forestry or MSc in Botany
* Exceptional talent with Diploma in Agriculture
* Knowledge of South Indian languages ideally Telugu \& Hindi are essential.

**Job specific requirements:**

***Experience \-***


* Freshers are welcome to apply
* 0–4 years of experience in agriculture, horticulture, or related field
* Experienced candidates from seed companies, fertilizer companies, or agri\-related firms are also considered

title: GUI / Computer-Use Video Data Annotator
description:
**About the Company**

Skyfall is disrupting the entire AI ecosystem by building the first world model for the enterprise. The goal of the ‘Enterprise World Model’ is to overcome the severe limitations of LLMs (Safety, Hallucinations, Expensive training) in order to provide enterprises significant value by having a comprehensive understanding of the complex interplay between data, people, and processes within organizations.

The Skyfall founding team consists of Maluuba founders who were previously pioneers in the Deep Learning revolution. Maluuba worked with AI pioneers such as Yoshua Bengio and Richard Sutton before it was acquired by Microsoft for $160M and became Microsoft’s AI research center in Canada.

**About the Role**

You will help build the training dataset that teaches our world model how humans use software. Our models learn to understand and predict computer\-use workflows from real screen recordings, and the quality of that learning is entirely dependent on the quality of the data you curate.

Working alongside the world modeling team, you will review large volumes of computer\-use videos, verify AI\-proposed labels, separate genuine task workflows from non\-workflow content, and flag noise and edge cases. This is precise, high\-volume, judgment\-driven work: every label you produce becomes ground truth the model trusts. A small, careless error can compound through training into a real failure in the deployed agent so accuracy, consistency, and integrity matter far more than raw speed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Verify AI\-proposed taxonomy labels (Domain, Subdomain, Software) on sampled videos, marking each as correct or incorrect against the labeling guide.
* Review video clips to determine whether they show genuine computer\-use workflows (step\-by\-step task completion) versus non\-workflow content (talking\-head commentary, passive browsing, discussion), following defined labeling criteria.
* Annotate visual noise in sampled video frames (zoom, overlays, cursor effects, callouts, transitions, etc.), applying one or more labels per frame per guidelines.
* Work through shared, trackable annotation buckets across datasets ranging from 1,000–5,000\+ videos.
* Flag ambiguous cases, edge cases, or tooling issues to the team rather than guessing, leaving clear notes to support escalation.
* Maintain consistent accuracy and pace against team\-set quality and throughput targets, adapting quickly as guidelines evolve.
* Surface gaps or ambiguities in the labeling guidelines and taxonomy so they can be refined over time.

**Core Requirements (Must\-Haves)**

**Attention to Detail, Judgment \& Integrity**

* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to stay consistent across long, repetitive, high\-volume work.
* Ability to follow detailed, evolving labeling guidelines precisely and apply them uniformly.
* Sound judgment to distinguish genuine workflows from non\-workflow content and to recognize edge cases.
* High integrity: prioritizes accuracy over throughput, and escalates ambiguity rather than guessing or forcing a label.

**Software \& Technical Fluency**

* Strong general computer literacy and comfort navigating desktop operating systems (Windows, macOS, or Linux), web browsers, and common productivity, creative, and developer software, enough to intuitively recognize what a real task workflow looks like.
* Comfortable working with web\-based annotation tools, spreadsheets, and trackers.
* Clear written English to document flags, notes, and edge cases unambiguously.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Computer Science, IT, or Engineering is a plus).
* 0–3 years in data annotation, QA / manual software testing, IT operations, or a similarly detail\-oriented, guideline\-driven role. Strong freshers with clear aptitude will be considered.
* Available to work full\-time on\-site at HSR Layout, Bengaluru for the duration of the 3\-month contract.

**Preferred (nice to have):**

* Prior experience in AI data operations, video/content auditing, e\-commerce/retail operations, or medical coding i.e., backgrounds that reward diligence under repetition.
* Basic understanding of how AI/ML models learn from training data.
* Familiarity with structured data formats (labels, JSON, taxonomies).

**Who Will Succeed in This Role**

* Someone who is meticulous, patient, process\-driven, and reliable under repetitive, high\-focus work.
* Someone who is just as precise and careful on their 400th video as on their 4th.
* Someone who treats ambiguity as a signal to pause and escalate, not an excuse to guess.

**What This Role Is Not**

* It is not a software engineering, development, or programming role.
* It is not a creative, content\-production, or design role.
* It is not suited to those who only use computers casually; it requires real desktop\-software fluency and comfort with high\-volume, repetitive precision work.

Pay: Up to ₹50,000\.00 per month

◦ P\&L

◦ Balance Sheet

◦ Cash Flow

* Preparation of MIS packs and variance analysis with commentary.

◦ Technical workings

* Research on sections, notifications, circulars and case laws.
* Drafting of internal technical notes, client advisories, transaction memos and opinion drafts under review.

**C. Litigation and Assessment Support**

* Assistance in handling Income Tax and GST notices, assessments and departmental queries.

◦ Replies to notices

◦ Reconciliations and submissions

◦ Paper books, annexures and supporting documentation

* Coordination with tax consultants, lawyers and auditors.
* Maintenance of litigation trackers and hearing calendars.

**D. Compliance Execution**

* GST return workings and filings (GSTR 1, 3B, 6, 9 / 9C).
* TDS computations, return filing and rectifications.
* Coordination on PF and Professional Tax.
* Data preparation for statutory, tax and internal audits.
* ROC filings under Companies Act and LLP Act.

**E. Client Coordination**

* Day to day follow ups with clients for data and information.

* Participation in client calls and meetings along with seniors.
* Preparation of email drafts, workings and client communications.

**F. Due Diligence and Reviews**

* Analysis of financial statements and schedules.
* Review of compliances and identification of red flags.
* Preparation of summaries of agreements.
* Drafting of preliminary due diligence reports under review.

**G. Process Discipline and Automation**

* Adherence to SOPs, internal controls and checklists.
* Maintenance of working papers and audit trails.
* Development and improvement of Excel based templates and trackers.
* Support process improvement and automation initiatives.

**3\. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA (MANDATORY)**

* Fresh Chartered Accountant; or
* Semi Qualified CA with 2 to 4 years of relevant experience; or
* Commerce Graduate / Post Graduate with 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in accounting and CFO services.

**4\. PREFERRED PROFILE**

* Articleship completed at a Big 4 firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) or top mid\-tier firm (Grant Thornton, BDO, BSR \& Co., S.R. Batliboi \& Co., MNS, MZSK, RSM, Walker Chandiok, Lodha, Singhi \& Co., etc.).
* Multi client / consulting environment exposure.
* Listed company, NBFC or manufacturing client exposure.

**5\. CORE COMPETENCIES**

**Category**

**Required Skills and Behaviours**

**Functional**

Strong accounting fundamentals; reconciliations and ledger scrutiny; MIS preparation and analysis; working knowledge of Income Tax and GST; documentation and assessment support.

**Technical**

Advanced Excel (SUMIFS, INDEX MATCH, lookup chains, pivots, data validation, conditional formatting, intro to Power Query); Tally and any ERP; clean drafting and presentation skills.

**Behavioural**

Strong learning orientation; ownership; attention to detail; effective communication; team collaboration; adherence to timelines.

**6\. NON NEGOTIABLE EXPECTATIONS**

* Ability to independently build a full set of financials in Excel from a trial balance, fully formula driven.

Associate → Senior Associate → Assistant Manager → Manager → Senior Manager → Associate Director → Partner Track.

The role is accountable for maintaining workforce stability, productivity, operational continuity and compliance while supporting plant commissioning, expansion and sustainable manufacturing operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Multi\-Plant HR Leadership, Workforce Planning \& Hiring** 



* Provide HR leadership across four manufacturing plants, ensuring consistent execution of people processes and governance across locations.
* Develop manpower plans aligned to production requirements, capacity expansion, automation initiatives and business growth plans.
* Ensure 100% manning against approved manpower budgets and structures through proactive workforce planning, timely recruitment, effective deployment and retention interventions.
* Own end\-to\-end hiring delivery for permanent employees, trainees, apprentices and contract workforce across all plant functions.

* Build talent pipelines for critical plant positions and future expansion requirements.

* Drive timely resolution of employee issues through structured communication and stakeholder engagement.

 The HRBP works closely with the business and HR teams to provide strategic leadership and support, delivering a world\-class employee experience to JioStar’s talent. This includes designing and executing talent strategies in alignment with business strategies, ensuring leaders and managers receive the necessary support in facilitating positive employee experiences throughout the employee lifecycle. You will play an active role in understanding the business, solving problems, and interpreting various workplace situations within the context of talent practices, policies, processes, and employment law.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our HR Business Partners are the front\-line business advisors and partners at JioStar. The team enables group and business units aligned talent strategies to enable our businesses thrive and succeed. They act as a bridge between the HR function and various business units in the organization. Some of the key aspects of HR Business partnering are having strategic alignment with the business, employee engagement, change management, digital transformation, DE\&I, talent management, L\&D and managing conflicts/problem solving. REPORTING TO: Human Resources Business Leader, Entertainment Cluster 3 (South)
   

  

 KEY RESPONSBILITIES:
   

  

 Enabling Business Strategies Align talent outcomes with business priorities; You will gain a deep understanding of business strategy, enabling you to translate it into talent strategy for multiple complex businesses. Creative talent solutions that impact both business and employee experience will be developed and driven by your efforts. This includes organizational transformation, engagement programs, recognition initiatives, performance management, learning and development, and retention strategies. Collaborative integration with stakeholders and Centers of Excellence (CoE) functional partners like Talent Acquisition, Organization and Talent Solutions, Compensation \& Benefits, Diversity Equity \& Inclusion, Employee Relations, and HR Operations will be facilitated by you to promote talent\-led solutions. As required, company\-wide initiatives and events will be championed by you for your business unit. Periodic reviews of headcount metrics will be conducted by you, leveraging workforce insights, evidence\-based research, and HR \& business metrics to aid in decision\-making and influence business solutions. You will manage multiple priorities and execute work in complex and matrixed segments/functions. Fostering Leadership Success You will anticipate the business cycle to help influence and engage with business leaders more effectively. You will build and maintain long\-term trusted relationships with employees and leaders. Influencing senior business leaders to take a long\-term view to engage and retain top talent will be a key role for you. You will work closely with leaders to enhance morale, productivity, and organizational effectiveness. As a trusted advisor, you will guide business leaders and employees while leading the implementation of ongoing succession and development plans for the organization. Managing the communication and transition plan for senior leaders undergoing significant business changes will be your responsibility. You will lead and champion an open and inclusive work environment true to the core values of JioStar. Shaping Employee Experience You will ensure that people have the right skills, tools, and talents to perform their roles effectively. Developing and driving strategies that foster an environment where all employees are respected and valued will be one of your responsibilities. You will advise leaders and employees on adhering to policies and practices that encourage openness, trust, appreciation, and respect. Ensuring employees are supported in finding how to access tools and documents that provide information about policies and practices for the company will also be part of your role.
   

  

 PREFERRED EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:
   

  

 Postgraduate or graduate in HR or Psychology 6\-8 years of experience as an HRBP; Blend of CoE and business partnering exposure is an added advantage Experience of working in high growth, disruptive industries Strong command of HR processes (PMS, comp cycles, talent reviews)
   

  

 SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS:
   

  

 Trusted thought partner to leaders; confident to challenge constructively; coach managers \& senior talent Strong in employee communication, culture\-building \& engagement design Demonstrated ability to manage simultaneous priorities across diverse functions/ businesses Resilience to work within a complex, matrixed organization and find creative solutions Strong conceptual ability coupled with a proven track record of implementing HR and organization initiatives Ability to thrive in a dynamic, ambiguous setup Ability to be proactive while working autonomously Excellent communication skills, with ability to assert, influence and collaborate Strong analytical skills – ability to draw insights \& build business cases using data Understanding of organizational dynamics Confident and non\-hierarchical thinker Out\-of\-the\-box thinker

title: Human Resources Specialist
job_function: Human Resources, Marketing, and Information Technology
description:
We are looking for a seasoned and strategic HR professional to join our organization as an HR Executive/ Manager. This leadership role is instrumental in shaping and implementing HR strategies that align with organizational goals. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in HR management, a deep understanding of HR functions, and the ability to drive positive organizational culture and employee engagement.
 



  





**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



1. Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with the overall business objectives.
2. Develop and implement strategies for performance evaluation, staffing, training, development, etc.
3. Bridging management and employee relations by addressing demands, grievances or other issues.
4. Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment processes, ensuring the attraction and retention of top talent.
5. Foster positive employee relations by addressing concerns, resolving conflicts, and promoting a healthy work environment.
6. Lead the performance management process, including goal setting, performance evaluations, and development plans.
7. Guide managers on performance\-related matters.
8. Identifying staffing needs and creating job descriptions.
9. Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies.
10. Identify training needs, develop training programs, and facilitate learning initiatives.
11. Analyze data and report to the board and senior managers using HR Metrics.
12. Review current HR technology and recommend more effective software (including HRIS and ERP).
13. Measure employee retention and turnover rates.
14. Create and run referral bonus programs.
15. Reviewing all the necessary management of HR department personnel on a daily basis.



  





**REQUIREMENTS:** 



1. 3\-8 years proven work experience as an HR Manager or similar role.
2. Familiarity with Human Resources Management Systems and Applicant Tracking Systems.
3. Proven experience in HR management, with a track record of successful HR initiatives.
4. In\-depth knowledge of labor laws and HR best practices. (particularly employment contracts, employee leaves and insurance).
5. Strong leadership and strategic thinking skills.



  





**BENEFITS:** 



1. Competitive salary package commensurate with skills and experience.
2. Opportunities for professional development and training to foster continuous growth.
3. Collaborative and supportive work environment that values innovation and creativity.
4. Flexible work timings, 5\-day work week, yearly appraisals, and refreshing breaks for work\-life balance.

title: Assistant Manager - HR Generalist

Their certified collections span gold, platinum, diamonds, and gemstones, ensuring options for every occasion and budget. To learn more, visit www.bluestone.com.
