 Mentorship and Career growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.
   

  

 Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. description:

* Manage Cloud Applications: Manage Application ID, provide cloud elasticity by auto\-scaling resources based on business requirements, and ensure DR and manual redundancy failover capabilities.

 Master's Degree

* Cloud\-Based Solution Support: Exposure to providing 24/7 technical support for cloud\-based solutions, including troubleshooting and resolving issues across various applications, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure components.

* Database Administration: Exposure to installing and configuring databases such as MYSQL, MSSQL, and PostgreSQL, including ensuring database security and performance.

title: IoT Firmware Developer
description:
At Tag\-N\-Trac, we provide an AI\-driven, full\-stack IoT traceability solution using custom smart labels and ultra\-low\-power devices. We use cutting\-edge technologies to enable end\-to\-end supply chain digitization, helping revolutionize supply chain, logistics, and inventory management by providing real\-time visibility into assets and shipments.
 



 Our team collaborates closely with Product and Engineering to architect, build, and maintain the technologies that power our IoT devices, core platform, customer\-facing APIs, and real\-time event processing — all tailored to the challenges of the supply chain industry. We tackle compelling technical problems using data from our fleet of IoT devices and sensors, and we foster a data\-driven mindset where good ideas are welcomed regardless of where they come from.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are seeking an IoT Firmware Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware for Tag\-N\-Trac’s connected (cellular and BLE) smart labels, sensors, gateways, and ultra\-low\-power devices. You’ll join an existing firmware team and work closely with hardware, platform, cloud, mobile, and product teams to deliver reliable, secure, and power\-efficient IoT products — from prototype through production and into the field.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 •    Design, implement, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for IoT devices, sensors, gateways, and edge hardware.
 



 •    Develop production\-quality C code for resource\-constrained, low\-power embedded environments.
 



 •    Implement wireless connectivity (4G LTE and low power LTE\-M, NB\-IoT, BLE, Wi\-Fi) and hardware interfaces/protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, MQTT, AWS IoT).
 



 •    Collaborate with hardware engineers on board bring\-up, schematic review, and hardware/software integration.
 



 •    Build and maintain secure OTA firmware update mechanisms.
 



 •    Optimize firmware for performance, memory footprint, reliability, and power efficiency.
 



 •    Debug hardware/firmware issues using lab equipment (debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and develop tests to validate quality.
 



 •    Support manufacturing test fixtures, production flashing, and field diagnostics for devices in deployment.
 



  




 Required Qualifications
 
 •    Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 •    3\+ years of hands\-on embedded firmware development for IoT or related products.
 



 •    Strong proficiency in C in resource\-constrained environments.
 



 •    Solid understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS or equivalent) — tasks, interrupts, concurrency, memory management.
 



 •    Knowledge of battery\-powered design — sleep modes, power profiling, energy optimization.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LTE\-M, NB\-IoT, Wi\-Fi) and standard hardware interfaces (UART/SPI/I2C).
 



 •    Experience with cloud\-connected IoT platforms — device provisioning, telemetry, OTA updates, AWS IoT or equivalent.
 



 •    Experience with manufacturing test fixtures, production flashing, device calibration, or field service diagnostics.
 



  




 Nice to Have
 
 •    Experience with build systems (Make, CMake), unit testing frameworks (Unity or equivalent), and Python scripting.
 



 •    Familiarity with regulatory, safety, or cybersecurity requirements for production devices (e.g., FCC certification).
 



 •    Familiarity with Git and collaborative engineering workflows.
 



  




 Success in the Role
 
 •    You are highly entrepreneurial, thrive on taking ownership of your impact, and take initiative to solve problems before they arise.
 



 •    You are an excellent collaborator and communicator who listens to others, asks thoughtful questions, and understands that startups are a team sport.
 



 •    You are excited by the prospect of working with teammates across distributed locations and time zones.
 



 •    You elevate the team’s competency and company culture.
 



  




 Why Tag\-N\-Trac
 
 Tag\-N\-Trac is driving disruption in the $8T logistics industry with a novel range of IoT devices and an AI\-first approach. Our customers and partners value our products for their grounding in industry thought leadership, execution agility, and product quality. You’ll have a real opportunity to create impact — both by accelerating our product offerings and by helping amplify our values.
 



 You will be working in\-office, collaborating with a small, mission\-focused team located at the prestigious T\-Hub in Hyderabad’s Knowledge City. The company is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
 


* *Principals only — we will not respond to submissions from recruiters.*

title: TCS NQT 2026 Registration Open
description:
Are you a recent or upcoming graduate looking to secure a high\-paying role in top multinational companies? The official
 **TCS NQT 2026 Registration open** 
 for the upcoming July exam cycle! By taking the highly esteemed
 **TCS iON National Qualifier Test 2026** 
 , you unlock direct placement opportunities not just within Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), but also across 4,000\+ top corporates including Jio, Asian Paints, and TVS Motor. Whether you are aiming for the high\-paying TCS Prime (up to ₹9\+ LPA) or the TCS Digital and Ninja profiles, this integrated cognitive and technical assessment is your universal gateway to a massive IT career. Role Overview
   

  

* Sit for the TCS iON National Qualifier Test 2026 to qualify for multiple prestigious software engineering and IT infrastructure roles globally.
* The TCS NQT 2026 right now provides a verified scorecard valid for 2 years, vastly expanding your off\-campus placement options.
* Based on your test scores in the Foundation and Advanced sections, you will be shortlisted for TCS Ninja, TCS Digital, or the elite TCS Prime categories.
* Work on cutting\-edge technologies like Cloud Infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence, and Big Data Analytics once placed in top tech firms.
* Bypass traditional resume screening by letting your NQT score directly prove your cognitive aptitude and advanced coding capabilities to recruiters.


**Qualifications**
* Undergraduate or Postgraduate students pursuing B.E., B.Tech, M.E., M.Tech, MCA, or M.Sc.
* Candidates must strictly belong to the graduating batches of 2024, 2025, or 2026\.
* A consistent academic record with a minimum of 60% aggregate (or equivalent CGPA) across Class 10th, Class 12th, Diploma, Graduation, and Post\-Graduation.
* Candidates must have no active backlogs or standing arrears at the time of appearing for the selection process.
* An educational gap of up to 24 months is permitted, provided valid document proof is submitted.


 How to fill tcs nqt 2026 application form step by step
   

  

* Create Your TCS NextStep Account:Crucial: You must select the ‘IT’ category.
* Go to the official TCS NextStep portal and click “Register Now”.
* Choose “IT” (Information Technology). Do not select ‘BPS’ unless you are specifically applying for non\-technical business process roles.
* Enter your personal email ID and verify it with the OTP.
* Enter your basic details, including the last 4 digits of your Aadhar card, along with your Name and Date of Birth exactly as they appear on your Aadhar.
* Submit to generate your Reference ID (it will start with ‘CT’ or ‘DT’) and create a password. Write this ID down immediately, as you will need it for all future logins.
* Fill the Detailed Application Form:
* Log back into the portal using your new Reference ID and password.
* Click on the “Application Form” tab.
* Complete all required sections: Personal Details, Academic and Work Experience Details, Other Details (Languages, Certifications), and the Smart Card form.
* Upload a recent passport\-sized color photograph and your updated CV.
* Review the preview form, agree to the terms, and click “Submit Application Form”.
* The Final Requirement: Apply for Drive:Failing to do this voids your application.
* Submitting the detailed application form is not the final step. You must return to the main portal dashboard.
* Click the “Apply for Drive” button. (If this button is missing, ensure you selected ‘IT’ as your category and entered a valid graduating year of 2024, 2025, or 2026\).
* Select your preferred test centers and top 3 preferred job locations, then hit “Apply”.
* Verify Your Application Status:
* Finally, click on “Track My Application” on the dashboard.
* Your status MUST reflect “Applied for Drive”. If it only says “Application Received,” you missed Step 3 and are not registered for the NQT exam. TCS will not send a confirmation email for this step, so this status page is your only proof.


**TCS NQT 2026 Active Backlog Rules Explained**
 The Backlog Criteria For TCS NQT Can Be Confusing. Here Is Exactly How It Works Based On The Stage Of Your Application
   

  

* At the time of Registration \& Exam: You are allowed a maximum of 1 active backlog. If you have 2 or more, you are strictly not eligible to apply.
* At the time of Interview: You must have 0 active backlogs. The TCS mandate states “No pending backlogs at the time of the selection process.” This means if you had 1 backlog during the exam, the result must be declared and cleared before you walk into the interview room. Document verification happens before the interview, and candidates with active arrears are sent home.
* At the time of Joining: All exams must be cleared within the normal course duration. No extended education is permitted.


***Pro\-Tip for Application** 
 :* 
 If your backlog result is expected to be declared before the interview, you can apply. However, ensure you update your application form accurately as soon as the results are out.
   

  

 Understanding the TCS NQT 24\-Month Academic Gap Rule
   

  

 The “24\-month gap” criteria is one of the strictest eligibility filters for TCS NQT. Candidates often miscalculate their gap or try to hide it, which leads to immediate disqualification during document verification. Here is exactly how TCS calculates this gap and what documentation your readers need to prepare.
   

  

**What Actually Counts as an Academic Gap?**
 TCS Looks At a Candidate’s Overall Academic History From Class 10th Up To Their Highest Qualification. The Total Combined Gap Must Not Exceed 24 Months (2 Years). This Cumulative Limit Includes
   

  

* Post\-Schooling Gaps: Taking a drop year after 12th standard for competitive exam preparation (like JEE or NEET).
* Pre\-Graduation/Post\-Graduation Gaps: Time taken off between completing a Bachelor’s degree and starting a Master’s degree.
* Medical/Personal Leaves: Any officially sanctioned break taken mid\-degree.


**The “Extended Education” Trap (What Is NOT Allowed)**
 A gap is
 *only* 
 permissible if it happens
 *between* 
 courses or as a formal, documented break.
 **Extended education is strictly prohibited** 
 .
   

  

* If a candidate takes 5 years to complete a 4\-year B.Tech degree because of accumulated arrears or failing a year, this is classified as “extended education,” not an academic gap. This results in automatic disqualification.


**Required Documentation For The Gap**
 It is strictly mandatory to declare any academic gap on the TCS NextStep application form. If a candidate hides it and it is discovered later, their candidature will be canceled for misrepresentation. During the interview phase, candidates must produce valid, verifiable proof for the gap duration.
   

  

* Affidavit on Stamp Paper (Gap Certificate): A legally notarized document explaining the exact reason for the break (e.g., preparation for competitive exams, financial constraints, or family issues). This is the most common and accepted proof.
* Medical Certificates: Authentic reports and doctor’s letters if the break was strictly due to severe health reasons.
* Official University Letters: Sanctioned leave letters from the college administration if the gap occurred mid\-degree.


 TCS NQT 2026: Role \& Package Tiers
   

  

**Tier Level** 
**Role Name** 
**Expected CTC (Fresher)** 
**Difficulty \& Skill Requirement** 
**Level 1** 
**TCS Ninja** 
 \~ ₹3\.36 LPA (UG/PG)
 **Foundation:** 
 Requires basic coding and aptitude. Achieved by clearing the Foundation section (Part A).
 **Level 2** 
**TCS Digital** 
 \~ ₹7\.09 – ₹7\.60 LPA (UG/PG)
 **Advanced:** 
 Requires strong technical skills. Achieved by scoring high in Foundation and partially clearing the Advanced section.
 **Level 3** 
**TCS Prime** 
 \~ ₹9\.09 – ₹11\.80 LPA (UG/PG)
 **Expert:** 
 Reserved for top percentile scorers. Requires solving complex advanced coding questions perfectly.
   

  

 Job Benefits
   

  

* Tiered Salary Packages: Exceptional starting CTCs based on performance: TCS Ninja (\~₹3\.3 LPA), TCS Digital (\~₹7 LPA), and TCS Prime (up to ₹9\.3\+ LPA).
* Corporate Access: The NQT scorecard gives you exclusive access to apply for over 1\.6 Lakh jobs across thousands of partnered corporate entities.
* Health \& Wellness: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage for employees and their immediate dependents once placed.
* Continuous Learning: Full access to TCS iON digital learning platforms and certifications to rapidly accelerate your career progression.
* Global Exposure: Opportunity to work on massive international projects and transition into specialized technical architectures early in your career.


 FAQs
   

  

**Q: When is the deadline for the current TCS NQT cycle?**
 A: For the upcoming July 2026 exam cycle, the registration deadline is
 **19th July 2026** 
 , with the test scheduled for
 **30th July 2026** 
 .
   

  

**Q: Where can I apply for the TCS NQT?**
 A: You must log on to the official TCS NextStep Portal, register under the “IT” category, fill out the detailed application form, and critically, click on “Apply For Drive”.
   

  

**Q: What is the exact syllabus for the TCS NQT?**
 A: The exam comprises two sections: Part A (Foundation) tests Numerical, Verbal, and Reasoning Ability; Part B (Advanced) tests Advanced Quantitative, Reasoning, and Advanced Coding skills.
   

  

**Q: Is the test conducted online or offline?** 
 A: The exam is typically conducted in\-person at authorized TCS iON test centers to maintain strict invigilation standards.
   

  

**Q: I passed out in 2024 / 2025\. Can I still apply for the 2026 drive?** 
 Yes. The TCS All India NQT Hiring is exclusively open to candidates from the
 **2024, 2025, and 2026** 
 batches. Older batches (2023 and earlier) are not eligible for this specific campus hiring drive.
   

  

**Q: Are MCA, M.Sc, or Diploma students eligible to apply?** 
**MCA and M.Sc (M.S.)** 
 students are fully eligible, provided they meet the 60% criteria. However, standalone Diploma holders are not eligible; you must have completed a full\-time undergraduate or postgraduate degree (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc) to apply.
   

  

**Q: I have a percentage of 59\.8%. Will it be rounded up to 60%?**
 No. TCS strictly requires a minimum of
 **60% or 6\.0 CGPA** 
 throughout your entire academic history (10th, 12th, Diploma, UG, and PG). TCS does not allow rounding off, meaning a 59\.9% will result in disqualification.
   

  

**Q: Can candidates with prior work experience apply?**
 Yes, freshers with
 **up to 2 years of work experience** 
 are eligible to apply for the TCS NQT 2026 drive. Candidates with more than 2 years of experience should look for lateral hiring opportunities instead.

title: Product Owner
description:
**Job Overview** 








 The Product Manager brings a high\-energy approach to developing customer\-centric e\-commerce user experiences and features that grow the customer base, drive user engagement, and improve the overall site experience. The role develops and owns execution of the product roadmap for the assigned product area and collaborates with cross\-functional partners across design, engineering, analytics, and business throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through execution. The Product Manager works in an agile environment focused on continuous improvement, where ideas and feedback are encouraged, and is empowered to make decisions that create memorable, loyalty\-building experiences for every customer.
 







**What You Will Do** 



* Develop and maintain a product roadmap aligned to business goals and product strategy by delivering key milestones and achieving defined KPIs.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap, and progress to partners across product lines.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve customer experiences through cross\-functional collaboration, data analysis, and deep understanding of customer needs.
* Define product and customer experiences through clear, detailed, and timely artifacts, including product requirements and user stories.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, analytics, and other product managers to design, build, and launch product features that drive growth and engagement.
* Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog of well\-groomed, insight\-driven user stories.
* Partner with engineering scrum teams and technical leads to refine requirements that support simple, intuitive user experiences.
* Define success metrics, ramp plans, and measurement criteria.
* Design and run experiments to test hypotheses and identify solutions that improve conversion, engagement, and customer loyalty.
* Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
* In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.



  





**Skills You Will Need** 








**Product Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership** 
 : Proven ability to define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps that align with business goals, product strategy, and KPIs while delivering measurable customer and commercial impact.
 







**Customer\-Centric Product Thinking** 
 : Deep commitment to understanding customer needs and behaviors, translating insights into intuitive, loyalty\-building e\-commerce experiences that improve engagement and satisfaction.
 







**Analytical Thinking \& Data\-Driven Decisions** 
 : Strong analytical rigor and first\-principles problem\-solving skills, with the ability to define success metrics, run experiments, interpret data, and apply insights to optimize conversion, engagement, and retention.
 







**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Collaboration** 
 : Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaborate effectively with design, engineering, analytics, and business partners across the full product lifecycle.
 







**Execution Excellence in Agile Environments** 
 : Strong execution skills with experience managing backlogs, grooming user stories, partnering with scrum teams, and delivering high\-quality outcomes in an agile, fast\-paced environment.
 







**Business Acumen \& E\-commerce Expertise** 
 : Solid understanding of retail and e\-commerce economics and business strategy frameworks, with the ability to balance customer value and commercial outcomes.
 







**Technical \& Product Development Fluency** 
 : Working knowledge of technical concepts, agile methodologies, and modern product development practices to effectively partner with engineering teams and make informed trade\-offs.
 







**Innovation \& Emerging Technology Awareness** 
 : Ability to stay ahead of emerging technologies and leverage them to build differentiated, scalable digital experiences.
 







**Communication \& Stakeholder Influence** 
 : Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product vision, progress, and trade\-offs to cross\-functional partners and senior leaders.
 







**Continuous Learning \& Growth Mindset** 
 : Curiosity\-driven, adaptable learner who actively seeks new methodologies, industry trends, and feedback to continuously improve products and ways of working.
 







**Who You Are** 



* Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. Previous work experience related to product strategy, product management, design, engineering, site merchandising, or management consulting preferably in a retail or ecommerce company required.
* Regularly required to sit, talk, hear; use hands/fingers to touch, handle, and feel. Occasionally required to move about the workplace and reach with hands and arms. Requires close vision.
* Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

Sumo Logic is seeking a Product Manager to define the future of our Security Operations platform. As a member of our product team, you will drive the vision and execution of Threat Detection and Response and define the intersection of AI and SecOps. Working across engineering, customer success, sales, and marketing, you will transform complex challenges into intuitive, powerful solutions that enable security teams to: detect threats faster, investigate with confidence, and respond decisively. This is an opportunity to shape products that directly impact how enterprises defend against evolving cyber threats while delivering measurable business value to customers.

* Defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an exceptional user experience and innovative Threat Detection and Response features that drive customer engagement and satisfaction across our platform.
* Collaborating with customers and stakeholders to gather and analyze user feedback, use cases, and requirements to ensure we meet their needs while enhancing the overall platform user experience.

* Working with cross\-functional teams to identify and gather platform requirements that enhance user experience and dashboard functionalities.

* Contributing to go\-to\-market strategies, collaborating with product marketing and sales to effectively communicate the value of our user experience and dashboarding capabilities.
* Developing sales enablement materials, including whitepapers, blogs, presentations, and product demos to showcase our dashboarding features.

* Experience in working with B2B SaaS products and the ability to navigate complex decision\-making environments.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a proven track record of effectively engaging with customers and cross\-functional teams.
* A data\-driven mindset, with the ability to use analytics to inform product decisions and prioritize development efforts.

 You will be working on one of the largest scale data problems in the industry. Your work directly impacts the company’s bottom line and determines our ability to innovate by freeing up capital for new product investments.

title: Product Manager
description:
Sumo Logic is seeking a Product Manager to define the future of our Security Operations platform. As a member of our product team, you will drive the vision and execution of Threat Detection and Response and define the intersection of AI and SecOps. Working across engineering, customer success, sales, and marketing, you will transform complex challenges into intuitive, powerful solutions that enable security teams to: detect threats faster, investigate with confidence, and respond decisively. This is an opportunity to shape products that directly impact how enterprises defend against evolving cyber threats while delivering measurable business value to customers.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for an exceptional user experience and innovative Threat Detection and Response features that drive customer engagement and satisfaction across our platform.
* Collaborating with customers and stakeholders to gather and analyze user feedback, use cases, and requirements to ensure we meet their needs while enhancing the overall platform user experience.
* Maintaining a detailed product roadmap supported by data analysis and competitive positioning to prioritize features and enhancements effectively.
* Working with cross\-functional teams to identify and gather platform requirements that enhance user experience and dashboard functionalities.
* Representing the voice of the customer to product engineering teams and executives, ensuring user needs are at the forefront of product development.
* Partnering with engineering teams to ensure our dashboarding solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant, making prioritization decisions as necessary.
* Contributing to go\-to\-market strategies, collaborating with product marketing and sales to effectively communicate the value of our user experience and dashboarding capabilities.
* Developing sales enablement materials, including whitepapers, blogs, presentations, and product demos to showcase our dashboarding features.


**What You Bring**
* 3\+ years of experience in product management, preferably with a focus on cybersecurity, and a proven track record of success in execution
* Strong understanding of security operations technologies (SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Threat Intelligence)
* Experience in working with B2B SaaS products and the ability to navigate complex decision\-making environments.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a proven track record of effectively engaging with customers and cross\-functional teams.
* A data\-driven mindset, with the ability to use analytics to inform product decisions and prioritize development efforts.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.


**Why Join Sumo Logic?**
 You will be working on one of the largest scale data problems in the industry. Your work directly impacts the company’s bottom line and determines our ability to innovate by freeing up capital for new product investments.
   

  

**About Us**
 Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI\-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.
   

  

 Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Technical / Product Publications, Engineer
description:
**You Are**
 You find clarity in complexity and know that good documentation is about what engineers can actually use when solving a problem, not just what looks complete. Writing energizes you, but so does understanding how something works well enough to explain it clearly. You ask the follow\-up questions until you understand the workflow, not just the feature list. At Synopsys, you will document IP libraries and EDA tools that power semiconductor design.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Creating documentation and training materials of complex tools and methodologies catering to Virtual Prototyping tools.
* Creating GUI\-based procedures/lab exercises on real\-time use cases.
* Co\-ordinate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and design teams to seek inputs and review feedbacks.
* Well versed with Windows and Linux platforms and ability to use the complex tools.
* Work on strict timelines and deliver docs with expected quality.
* Maintain the docs/trainings to be always in sync with the latest tool version.
* Be a good team player and contribute to meeting team assignments.
* Adhere to the conventions as per the Synopsys Style Guide in documentation.


**The Impact You Will Have**
* Engineers using Synopsys IP and EDA tools will find answers faster because your documentation is clear, structured, and actually matches how they work.
* Product releases will ship with complete, accurate documentation that reduces support escalations and improves customer experience.
* Design teams will spend less time answering the same questions because the manuals you write cover the right scenarios in the right depth.
* Documentation quality and consistency will improve across the product line as you apply and refine Synopsys style standards.


**What You'll Need**
* B.Tech/B.Sc/ MCA in Computer Science with basic programming knowledge and entry\-level experience writing technical documentation (e.g., user manuals, developer guides, or product documentation).
* Strong command of written English with attention to grammar, structure, and clarity; familiarity with American English spelling conventions.
* Hands\-on experience authoring in DITA XML and comfort working directly with XML code.
* Familiarity with software development life cycles and document development life cycles.
* Ability to learn new tools and technical domains quickly, ask clarifying questions, and translate complex information into usable content.
* Experience with Oxygen Author or similar structured authoring tools is a strong plus.
* Background in EDA, semiconductor, or technical software documentation is a plus.


**Who You Are**
* You are comfortable managing multiple documentation projects at once, tracking reviews, and keeping stakeholders aligned without losing details.
* You push back when a review comment is vague or contradictory, and you work with SMEs to get to the real answer.
* You treat deadlines seriously and know how to scope work so documentation ships when the product does.
* Work with the team to deliver the doc deliverables on time for every release with high quality standards.
* You will use the JIRA Issue tracking system to fetch the details on the required doc changes and follow the outlined procedure to address the requests.
* You will use all the automations setup in the team and follow the Styleguide to author the DITA XML topics.
* Follow integrity and strive to meet the release deadlines.
* Use AI\-driven setup to add automation in editing XML documents.


**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
 You will join a technical publications team that works closely with product development, IP engineering, and EDA tool teams across Synopsys. The team collaborates across geographies to document complex semiconductor design tools and methodologies, ensuring that engineers worldwide have the resources they need to use Synopsys products effectively.
   

  

**Rewards And Benefits**
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

 • Coach Agile Practices: Guide the team and organization on how to use Agile/Scrum practices and values to deliver value.
 



 • Remove Impediments: Actively work to identify and eliminate obstacles that may hinder the team’s progress.
 



 • Support Product Owner: Assist the Product Owner with backlog management, refinement, and ensuring clear communication of goals and priorities.
 



 • Promote Team Collaboration: Foster open communication, collaboration, and self\-organization within the team.
 



 • Drive Continuous Improvement: Encourage a culture of learning, adaptation, and continuous improvement through regular feedback and process enhancements.
 



 • Maintain Scrum Artifacts: Ensure transparency by maintaining and sharing Scrum artifacts such as the product backlog, sprint backlog, and burndown charts.
 



 • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a liaison between the team and stakeholders, ensuring alignment and managing expectations.
 



 • Monitoring: Track and measure progress and quality against Sprint Plan, DoD, Quality, Delivery Flow metrics
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
 



 • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification (SAFe Agilist good to have)
 



 • 4\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar Agile role working in POD model and facilitating collaboration across multiple PODs through events like the Scrum of Scrums.
 



 • Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) cleared at level N2 or higher
 



 Language Proficiency
 



  





 • English – A high degree of fluency is essential for all verbal and written communication
 



 • Japanese – Minimum requirement of Japanese language proficiency at the JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test) N2 level or higher
 



 Essential Skills
 



 • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, especially Scrum and scaled Agile environment (SAFe)
 



 • Excellent facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Experience working with cross\-functional teams catering to complex business environments operating at scale in hybrid work environments.
 



 • Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC), aspects of project planning and estimation, risk identification, capacity and dependency resolution.
 



 • Ability to coach and mentor team members on Agile best practices on Lean delivery practices and product delivery tools such as JIRA boards. Leading role\-based trainings – Product Owner, Scrum Master, Development team

 • Proficient in Agile project management tools (such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, and Rally), with experience building dashboards to enhance transparency of delivery metrics.
 



 • Enable teams to deliver value by leveraging flow metrics, Objective Key Results (OKRs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Automation Business Analyst (RPA & Agentic AI)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
 **Automation Business Analyst** 
 to join our Intelligent Automation team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in business analysis for automation initiatives, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Intelligent Automation, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions.
 



  





 The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, developers, and project managers to identify automation opportunities, gather and document requirements, define AI\-driven workflows, and support the successful delivery of automation and AI solutions.
 



  





 This role requires a strong understanding of business processes, automation technologies, and emerging AI capabilities, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable automation and Agentic AI solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Process Discovery \& Analysis** 



* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process discovery sessions to understand current business processes.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities across business functions.
* Analyze existing processes and recommend optimization and automation strategies.
* Perform feasibility assessments and process suitability analysis for RPA and Agentic AI implementations.
* Develop business cases and quantify expected benefits such as effort savings, productivity gains, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.



  





**Requirements Gathering \& Documentation** 



* Gather, analyze, validate, and document business and functional requirements.
* Create and maintain:



 \- Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
 



 \- Process Definition Documents (PDDs)
 



 \- Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs)
 



 \- User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
 



 \- Process Flow Diagrams
 



 \- Business Process Maps
 



 \- Solution Requirement Specifications
 


* Ensure requirements are complete, accurate, and aligned with business objectives.



  





**Automation \& AI Solution Design Support** 



* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Development teams during solution design and implementation.
* Support the design of RPA, Intelligent Automation, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Define business rules, decision points, exception handling scenarios, and AI workflow requirements.
* Assist in translating business requirements into automation and AI solution designs.
* Participate in solution walkthroughs and design reviews.



  





**Agentic AI \& Generative AI Initiatives** 



* Gather and document requirements for AI Agent, Generative AI, and AI\-powered workflow automation solutions.
* Define agent workflows, business rules, decision\-making processes, and user interaction requirements.
* Work with technical teams to design AI\-driven use cases involving Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, Knowledge Assistants, Intelligent Document Processing, and Conversational AI solutions.
* Assist in defining prompts, guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop requirements.
* Support testing and validation of AI\-generated outputs against business expectations.



  





**Testing \& Deployment Support** 



* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Production Validation activities.
* Create test scenarios and test cases based on business requirements.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders during UAT cycles.
* Support production deployments and hypercare activities.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, solution discussions, and review sessions.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide regular updates on requirements and project progress.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6 \- 8 years of Business Analysis experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience working on Automation, Intelligent Automation, or Digital Transformation projects.
* Hands\-on experience in automation projects utilizing platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Power Automate, or similar technologies.
* Mandatory experience working on Agentic AI, Generative AI, AI Agents, Conversational AI, Intelligent Document Processing, or AI\-powered workflow automation initiatives.
* Experience gathering and documenting requirements for automation and AI\-driven solutions.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Mandatory Skills:** 




  





**Business Analysis** 



* Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
* Process Discovery
* Process Mapping
* Gap Analysis
* User Story Creation
* Functional Documentation
* Business Process Improvement
* UAT Support



  





**Intelligent Automation** 




  




* Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
* Workflow Automation
* Automation Opportunity Assessment
* Process Optimization



  





**Agentic AI \& Generative AI** 




  




* Agentic AI Concepts and Workflows
* Generative AI Use Cases



  





**Tools** 



* UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Power Automate, or equivalent automation platforms
* Visio, Lucidchart, Draw.io, or equivalent process\-mapping tools
* Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent Agile project management tools



  





**Key Competencies**

* Help organizations achieve measurable business value through automation and AI\-driven transformation.

title: Temenos Transact FX Business Analyst
description:
Capgemini is seeking a skilled Temenos Transact FX Business Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring the successful implementation and enhancement of Temenos Transact FX solutions. You will gather and analyze business requirements, provide insights into foreign exchange operations, and support system configuration to drive business improvements and operational efficiency.
   

  

 As a Temenos Transact FX Business Analyst, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications, validate system functionalities, and participate in UAT processes. You will play a crucial role in facilitating communications between business units and IT to ensure system alignment with business goals.
   

  

 The key requirements of this multi\-facted role are:
   

  

**Business Analysis \& Requirements**
* Engage with business stakeholders (Front Office, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Risk, Compliance) to elicit and document FX business requirements within a core banking context
* Analyse existing FX processes and define target\-state FX operating models aligned to Temenos Transact capabilities
* Produce high\-quality artefacts including:
* Business Requirements Documents (BRD)
+ Functional Specifications (FS)
+ Process flows and swimlane diagrams
+ Data mappings and interface specifications

* Ensure clear traceability of requirements through design, build, test, and deployment


**Temenos Transact FX Functional Expertise**
* Act as the functional SME for FX in Temenos Transact, including:
+ FX deal capture (spot, forward, swaps \- as applicable)
+ Deliverable FX products (sport and forward)
+ Non\-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for restricted currencies
+ FX rates, spreads, and pricing models
+ FX settlement and nostro/vostro processing
+ FX accounting and P\&L treatment
+ Revaluation and end\-of\-day processing

* Configure and support Transact FX\-related components in collaboration with technical teams (no standalone TAP configuration)
* Advise on standard Transact functionality vs. customisation, promoting out\-of\-the\-box usage where possible


**Integration \& Data**
* Define and support FX\-related integrations between Transact and surrounding systems, such as:
* Trading or order capture systems
+ Market data / rate providers
+ Payments engines and clearing systems
+ GL, Finance, Risk, and Regulatory Reporting platforms
+ Produce FX data mappings covering deal lifecycle, rates, settlements, and accounting entries
+ Support reconciliation processes across FX, payments, and accounting systems


**Testing \& Delivery Support**
* Support SIT, UAT, and regression testing phases for FX scope:
* Review and validate FX test scenarios and test cases
* Support defect triage and resolution
* Validate FX results (rates, settlements, accounting postings)
* Work closely with product owners and delivery leads to ensure FX scope is delivered on time and to quality
* Support cutover, migration, and go\-live activities related to FX portfolios


**Requirements**
**Essential**
 Strong Business Analyst experience on Temenos Transact (T24\) programmes
   

  

 8\+ years of experience delivering FX functionality within a Transact core banking environment, including:
   

  

* FX Spot and FX Forward products
* Non‑Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for emerging or restricted currencies
* Understanding of deliverable vs non‑deliverable FX settlement models
* FX lifecycle from deal capture through settlement, accounting, and revaluation
* Interaction between FX products, payments, and core banking accounting


 Solid understanding of:
   

  

* FX products and lifecycle
* FX settlements and accounting
* Interaction between FX and payments
* Experience working in large\-scale banking transformation programmes
* Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills


**Desirable**
* Experience in Private Banking or Wealth Management environments
* Knowledge of regulatory considerations impacting FX (e.g. MiFID II, EMIR, best execution \- where applicable)
* Experience working across multi\-country or multi\-entity banking rollouts
* Prior experience replacing or integrating with standalone FX/trading platforms (including TAP) is an advantage


**Soft Skills:**
* Client facing
* Confident and articulate
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Able to build relationship with business stakeholders and other team members
* Ability to lead a team


**Benefits**
 Competitive compensation and benefits package:
   

  

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group

description:
**Meet the Moment with Alteryx**
 We're living through a once\-in\-a\-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision \- and Alteryx is leading the transformation.
   

  

 You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.
   

  

 If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.
   

  

 We're looking for Backend Software Engineers who are curious, technically strong, and passionate about solving complex engineering challenges at scale. In this role, you'll help build the platform services, APIs, and backend systems that power next\-generation analytics experiences across Alteryx products, including AI\-assisted workflows, automated insights, governed data experiences, and enterprise\-scale analytics automation.
   

  

 If you enjoy designing highly scalable backend systems, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, and building products that enable customers to make smarter decisions using data and AI, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 At Alteryx, we believe great products are built by diverse teams where everyone is empowered to contribute, challenge ideas, and grow. Success here comes from ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and an unwavering focus on customer value.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Backend Software Engineer, you'll work closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, AI engineers, and quality engineers to design, develop, and deliver scalable backend services that power the Alteryx Analytics Cloud Platform.
   

  

**You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance backend services, APIs, and platform components.
* Build scalable cloud\-native services supporting data\-intensive workloads, analytics automation, and AI\-powered product capabilities.
* Develop backend capabilities that enable AI\-assisted workflow creation, automated insights, governed data access, and enterprise analytics.
* Collaborate with engineering, platform, product, and AI teams to deliver customer\-centric solutions.
* Write clean, secure, maintainable, and well\-tested code following engineering best practices.
* Participate in technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews.
* Debug complex production issues while improving system reliability, scalability, observability, and performance.
* Contribute throughout the software development lifecycle—from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Continuously improve engineering processes, CI/CD pipelines, automation, and developer productivity.
* Stay current with modern backend technologies, cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and AI innovations to build meaningful customer experiences.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 2\+ years of professional experience building backend applications, distributed systems, or platform services.
* Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python.
* Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals including:
+ Object\-oriented programming
+ Data structures \& algorithms
+ Design patterns
+ RESTful APIs
+ Distributed systems

* Experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, or cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical problem\-solving skills.
* Experience writing maintainable, testable code with appropriate unit and integration testing.
* Understanding of backend scalability, reliability, security, observability, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication skills with a collaborative, ownership\-driven mindset.
* Interest in AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or intelligent automation and their application in modern analytics platforms.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building data platforms, analytics products, workflow automation platforms, or business intelligence solutions.
* Knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and query optimization.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and observability tools.
* Exposure to AI/ML systems, LLM\-powered applications, prompt orchestration, model serving, or AI governance.
* Experience developing secure enterprise\-grade software.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.


 Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
   

  

 This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

title: Software Engineer
description:
****Career Area:****
 Technology, Digital and Data
   

  

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

 ROLE DEFINITION
   

  

 Designs, develops, and maintains hybrid mobile applications (iOS, Android, PWA) within a large\-scale NX monorepo. Writes clean, performant, and testable code using modern Angular and Ionic/Capacitor, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality mobile experiences for fleet management users.
   

  

 DEGREE REQUIREMENT
   

  

 B. Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or a related field from an accredited institution (or equivalent professional experience).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and enhance features for a hybrid mobile application targeting iOS, Android, and PWA using Angular, Ionic, and Capacitor.
* Develop standalone Angular components with lazy\-loaded routing, Angular Signals, and reactive patterns (RxJS) to deliver responsive and maintainable UIs.
* Implement and consume native device capabilities (camera, geolocation, push notifications, filesystem, and platform sensors) through Capacitor plugins.
* Write and maintain unit tests using Jest with Angular TestBed, MockStore, and HttpClient testing utilities to ensure code reliability.
* Work within an NX monorepo containing multiple feature and shared libraries.
* Translate high\-level designs into low\-level implementation, creating models, services, and facades that align with established architectural patterns.
* Monitor and optimize mobile UI performance through lazy loading, code splitting, caching, and bundle\-size management.
* Troubleshoot platform\-specific issues across iOS, Android, and web, analyzing logs, native bridges, and runtime behavior.


**Required Skills**
* Angular 19\+ (Standalone Components): Standalone component architecture, dependency injection via inject(), Angular Signals, lazy\-loaded routing with guards, and HTTP interceptors.
* Ionic 7 \+ Capacitor 7: Hybrid mobile development with Ionic UI components, Capacitor native bridge, platform\-specific behavior handling, Auth Connect, and Identity Vault.
* TypeScript 5\.5\+ (Strict Mode): Strong typing with interfaces, generics, type guards, strict null checks, and no implicit any.
* RxJS 7: Reactive programming with Observables, Subjects, key operators (switchMap, combineLatest, forkJoin, etc.), and subscription lifecycle management.
* NX Monorepo (pnpm): Workspace architecture with 80\+ libraries, project boundaries, affected\-based CI, and pnpm package management.
* Mobile and Native Patterns: Capacitor plugin integration (camera, geolocation, push notifications, filesystem), deep linking, PWA/Service Worker, and app lifecycle management across iOS, Android, and web.
* Unit Testing with Jest: Angular TestBed testing with mocking (jest.fn, jest.spyOn, provideMockStore), fakeAsync/tick, and Ionic web component schemas.
* Data Visualization: Chart.js for graphs, Google Maps API for map rendering and geofences, and D3\.js for Gantt/timeline charts.
* Real\-Time Communication: WebSocket integration using RxJS webSocket() for live data updates with authenticated connections.
* Internationalization (i18n): Multi\-language support using TranslateModule/Transloco patterns with language selection flows and translation key conventions.
* Firebase Analytics: Custom event tracking and screen view logging integration.
* Facade Pattern: Abstraction layer over state management, encapsulating store dispatch and selector logic behind clean service APIs.


 SKILL DESCRIPTORS
   

  

 Problem Solving
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyse risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact\-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.


 Software Development Life Cycle
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Works with a formal life cycle methodology (Agile/Scrum).
* Explains phases, activities, dependencies, deliverables, and key decision points.
* Identifies common issues, problems, and considerations for each phase of the life cycle.
* Interprets product development plans and functional documentation.


 Performance Intelligence
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Utilize monitoring tools to analyse mobile application performance metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Implement techniques such as lazy loading, code splitting, and caching strategies to enhance application performance.
* Manage bundle budgets (initial 6MB warning / 12MB error) and optimize asset delivery.
* Profile and resolve platform\-specific performance bottlenecks on iOS and Android.


 Technical Troubleshooting
   

  

**Level Working Knowledge:**
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyse complex problems across web and native layers.
* Analyses code, logs, native bridge calls, and device\-specific behavior as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Debugs Capacitor plugin issues, platform\-specific rendering problems, and auth/vault errors.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, resolution steps, and tools used.


 This position requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

 Relocation is available for this position.

 scanning and scan filtering, ciphering, GATT services/characteristics, and hardware
 



 communication protocols for smart devices
 



 ● Implement UI/UX following design specifications and Material Design guidelines
 



 ● Collaborate closely with the Cloud/Web team on API integration
 



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 Core Android \& Language
 



 ● Expert\-level native Android development (Kotlin, Android SDK)

 judgment on when to use each; Material Design
 



 ● Concurrency: Coroutines and Flow (StateFlow / SharedFlow), structured concurrency;
 



 thread\-safety and race\-condition handling; approaches when coroutines are not available
 



  





 Architecture \& Design
 



 ● MVVM and Clean Architecture in depth; MVC vs MVVM trade\-offs; Use Cases / domain
 



 layer and how to unit\-test it
 



 ● Dependency Injection (Hilt / Dagger); designing reusable UI and common features
 



 shared across the project
 



 Background Work \& Performance
 



 ● Long\-running and background operations: WorkManager, foreground/background
 



 services, Doze and app\-standby behaviour; surviving process death mid\-operation
 



 ● Efficient large\-list rendering (RecyclerView, ListAdapter, Paging), including poor\-network
 



 scenarios; diagnosing image\-recycling / mismatch issues
 



 ● Reliable bulk database writes (e.g., large dataset inserts); caching strategies, eviction
 



 policies and TTL
 



 APIs, Networking \& Security
 



 ● RESTful and GraphQL integration (incl. GraphQL configuration and schema\-change
 



 handling); awareness of SOAP trade\-offs
 



 ● Where and how to configure timeouts; optimizing multiple / parallel API calls; response caching
 



 ● Token\-based auth: JWT (payload/claims), refresh tokens and expiry handling, SSO,
 



 Cognito or similar
 



 ● Certificate / SSL pinning; secure credential storage Data \& Persistence
 



 ● Room (Entity / DAO / Database) and other persistence mechanisms; secure storage of
 



 sensitive data
 



 ● Hands\-on Android BLE: full flow (scanning → connection → service discovery →
 



 communication → disconnection)
 



 ● BLE operation queue management and prioritization (incl. reprioritizing or discarding
 



 queued operations); scan filtering by Service UUID, device name and manufacturer data;
 



 GATT/ATT, services and characteristics
 



 ● MTU handling (max size, dynamic negotiation) and packet\-size limits; Notify vs Indicate;
 



 response parsing; acknowledgements and reliable byte\-level transfer; exponential retry
 



 and reconnection (incl. why to wait before reconnecting)
 



 ● Ciphering and encrypted device communication; OTA firmware\-update considerations;
 



 awareness of vendor/OS differences (e.g., Pixel vs Samsung, Android vs iOS, Android
 



 12 Bluetooth changes) and location\-permission requirements (FINE vs COARSE)
 



 Notifications, Analytics \& Observability

 and use cases; payload structure / parsing and resilience to backend payload changes
 



 ● Firebase Analytics (custom events, event tracking) and Crashlytics; which crash types

 ● Memory\-leak detection (LeakCanary), including integration with CI/CD
 



 Quality, Tooling \& Delivery

 multiple build types / flavors

 From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
   

  

 Working at Myntra is challenging but fun \- we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
   

  

 Overview As a Demand Planning Analyst, you will play a critical role in forecasting and managing demand to optimize supply chain resource planning and ensure customer satisfaction. You will utilize data analysis, statistical techniques, and market insights to develop accurate demand forecasts and drive strategic decision\-making within the organization. Your efforts will contribute directly to the company's success by ensuring efficient supply chain operations and meeting customer demand effectively. Responsibilities 1\. Demand Forecasting: Utilize historical sales data, market trends, and other relevant factors to develop accurate demand forecasts. 2\. Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams including sales, marketing, finance, and supply chain to gather insights, align on forecast assumptions, and communicate demand expectations. 4\. Demand Planning Process: Drive the demand planning process from demand review meetings to consensus forecasting, ensuring alignment across all stakeholders and departments. 6\. Performance Metrics: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as forecast accuracy, service levels, providing insights and recommendations for improvement. 7\. Market Analysis: Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and macroeconomic factors to anticipate changes in demand patterns and adjust forecasts accordingly. 8\. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and system enhancements to streamline demand planning processes and improve efficiency. The incoming candidate should demonstrate ownership of projects from conceptualization through to execution.  Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing business needs.  Ability to collaborate \- Cultivate collaborative relationships with colleagues across departments and provide support to analysts within the team. Education and Experience Required:  BE/BTech from Tier 1 institute \& with a professional experience of 0\-2 years  Professional experience in e\-commerce / Retail / Analytics

description:
**Job description**

As the Instruction Specialist , you would be responsible for facilitating Pi Labs at partner government and affordable private schools to create a high\-quality computer science education ecosystem for student learning. This would include exhibiting excellent teaching,a well\-balanced, analytical and creative mindset to problem\-solve and provide innovative solutions,along with taking the initiative to own and build a part of their own core values that concur with the organizational vision and genuinely commit themselves to ensure that the value our program adds to a student’s life is sustainable, meaningful and more significant than individual motivations.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**  
As an Instruction Specialist, you will support all current and future educational initiatives and programs. Your portfolio will include:  
● Program Delivery  
○ Ensure optimum instructional delivery of Curriculum across the specified grades in assigned school(s). This will involve teaching (\& travel) in classrooms spread across the city/ district.  
○ Creation of monthly grade\-specific goals and daily lesson plans with the help of the Program Manager in line with curriculum and teaching philosophy. Instruction specialists will also be expected to file reports after each class.  
○ Keep track of student attendance, assess and Monitor Student Learning Outcomes and accomplishments in various ways(Assessments, Projects, Quiz, etc) regularly and provide progress reports as required  
○ Coordinate with school authorities to ensure adequate instructional time and maintenance of the lab.  
● Training and Capacity Building  
○ Participates in professional growth and development and stays abreast of current research through continuing education, educational seminars, workshops, conferences,  
and membership in the profession  
○ Participate in sessions during the beginning of the year training programme or as per the schedule shared by the organization.  
○ Participate in the monthly learning circles to share best practices with other teachers and prepare for the upcoming classes  
○ Work with the Program Manager to build teaching capacity as per their feedback  
● Event  
○ Coordinate with school authorities and conduct a school/ annual showcase for the students in your school. Mentors selected students for the annual Pi Jam event.  
○ Conduct hackathons, quizzes, and field visits for students to increase interest and provide learning experiences.  
○ Support Team in basic operational and program/event requirements for the annual event(s).

**Additional Responsibilities**  
Contribute to the development and growth of the organisation services and support for out\-of\-classroom programs, workshops, additional R\&D activities for program/curriculum testing, the impact and analysis process, recruitment and performance appraisals and team\-wide decision making.

**Required Qualifications:**  
Each core responsibility outlined above needs specific skills to fulfill. While many of these will be developed and honed through the role, some of the following are skills and mindsets we would like you to bring with you to the role and organization:  
● Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree from an accredited university or equivalent experience  
● Have a well\-balanced, analytical and creative mindset to problem\-solve and provide innovative solutions  
● Have relationship management skills and the ability to build rapport with stakeholders  
● Be an intellectually curious and responsive team contributor, delivering and receiving feedback regularly, and eager to learn and stay up to date on computer science education.

Pay: ₹9,436\.35 \- ₹39,650\.52 per month

**Job Summary**

The Senior Executive – Accounts Payable is responsible for managing the organization's accounts payable function, ensuring timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, payments, statutory compliance, account reconciliations, and maintaining strong vendor relationships. The role requires adherence to company policies, financial controls, and accounting standards.

**Key Responsibilities**Accounts Payable Management

* Process vendor invoices accurately and within defined timelines.
* Verify invoices against Purchase Orders (PO), Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), and approved agreements.
* Ensure proper approval workflows before processing payments.
* Prepare payment schedules for NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, and cheque payments.
* Monitor vendor ageing reports and ensure timely settlement of outstanding dues.
* Resolve invoice discrepancies by coordinating with procurement, stores, and vendors.

Vendor Management

* Maintain vendor master data accurately.
* Reconcile vendor statements regularly.
* Address vendor queries related to payments and outstanding balances.
* Build and maintain healthy vendor relationships.

Accounting \& Reconciliation

* Post purchase invoices and payment entries in the ERP system.
* Perform monthly vendor ledger reconciliations.
* Reconcile advance payments and supplier deposits.
* Ensure proper accounting of debit notes, credit notes, and purchase returns.

Compliance

* Verify GST compliance on purchase invoices.
* Ensure accurate deduction and payment of TDS wherever applicable.
* Maintain supporting documents for statutory and internal audits.
* Comply with company financial policies and accounting standards.

MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly Accounts Payable reports.
* Generate ageing analysis of creditors.
* Assist in monthly and year\-end closing activities.
* Provide payment forecasts and cash flow requirements to management.

Internal Controls

* Ensure adherence to internal financial controls.
* Maintain proper documentation for all transactions.
* Support internal, statutory, and tax audits.
* Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and controls.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable processes.
* Good understanding of GST, TDS, and accounting principles.
* Experience in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics NAV/Business Central, Tally, etc.).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas).
* Strong analytical and reconciliation skills.
* Excellent communication and vendor management abilities.
* Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Team coordination and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Food Manufacturing

* Restaurant Chains
* Sweets \& Savouries Manufacturing \& Retail

* Retail

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Vendor invoices processed within SLA.
* Payment accuracy and timeliness.
* Vendor reconciliation completion rate.
* Reduction in overdue payments.
* Compliance with GST and TDS regulations.
* Accuracy of AP records and reporting.
* Audit observations related to Accounts Payable.
* Vendor satisfaction and query resolution turnaround time.

* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B.Com)
* M.Com / MBA (Finance) preferred
* CA Inter (Preferred)

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Accounts Payable.
